104/**
105 * Defines the initial configuration of a <c>RestServlet</c> or <c>@Rest</c> annotated object.
106 *
107 * <p>
108 * An extension of the {@link ServletConfig} object used during servlet initialization.
109 *
110 * <p>
111 * Configuration is supplied declaratively through the {@link Rest @Rest} annotation on the resource class
112 * (and inherited from any parent classes), and programmatically through {@link Bean @Bean}-annotated
113 * methods/fields that contribute named beans (e.g. <c>encoders</c>, <c>parsers</c>, <c>restDebugFormatter</c>) to
114 * the REST resource's bean store. Where direct construction is needed (test rigs, mock clients, embedded usage),
115 * the public constructor takes a {@link RestContext.Args} record carrying the bootstrap state.
116 *
117 * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
118 * <p class='bjava'>
119 *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(path=<js>"/myresource"</js>, serializers=JsonSerializer.<jk>class</jk>, parsers=JsonParser.<jk>class</jk>)
120 *    <jk>public class</jk> MyResource {
121 *
122 *       <jc>// Programmatically contribute a bean to the resource's bean store.</jc>
123 *       <ja>@Bean</ja>
124 *       <jk>public</jk> RestDebugFormatter restDebugFormatter() {
125 *          <jk>return new</jk> MyCustomRestDebugFormatter();
126 *       }
127 *    }
128 * </p>
129 *
130 * <p>
131 * The historical <c>public MyResource(RestContext.Builder builder)</c> constructor-injection pattern and the
132 * <c>{@link RestInit @RestInit} public void init(RestContext.Builder builder)</c> method-injection pattern were both
133 * removed in 10.0. {@code RestContext.Builder} itself is on the deletion path; new code should not depend on it.
134 * See <a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/V10MigrationGuide">v10.0 Migration Guide</a>
135 * for replacement recipes.
136 *
137 * <h2 class='section'>Notes:</h2><ul>
138 *    <li class='note'>This class is thread safe and reusable.
139 *    <li class='note'>
140 *       No authentication, authorization or CSRF filter is registered by default; those are opt-in
141 *       (see {@link CsrfBoundary} and the auth modules).
142 *       The one default request check is the cross-site refusal for unsafe methods:  a request using a method other
143 *       than <c>GET</c>, <c>HEAD</c>, <c>OPTIONS</c> or <c>TRACE</c> is answered with a <c>403</c> when the browser marks it
144 *       <c>Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site</c>, or when its <c>Origin</c> does not match the <c>Host</c>.
145 *       It is on unless {@link Rest#allowCrossSite()} is set, and {@link Rest#allowedOrigins()} lists trusted origins.
146 * </ul>
147 *
148 * <h2 class='section'>See Also:</h2><ul>
149 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestContext">RestContext</a>
150 * </ul>
151 */
152@SuppressWarnings({
153   "java:S112", // RuntimeException used in memoizer lambdas to re-wrap checked exceptions (ServletException/Exception) that Supplier<T> cannot declare
154   "java:S125", // Explanatory comments reference SVL (${C:...}/${E:...}) and annotation (@Bean/@Rest) tokens that Sonar misreads as commented-out code
155   "java:S1141", // Nested try/catch blocks required for granular error reporting during initialization.
156   "java:S1192", // Duplicate string literals are property key names and REST annotation attribute values; intentional
157   "java:S1200", // Class has many dependencies; acceptable for this core context class
158   "java:S2259", // Values are non-null by construction or guarded by earlier checks that static flow analysis does not track.
159   "java:S3776", // Cognitive complexity in field-initializer lambdas (memoizer wiring); cannot annotate at lambda scope
160   "java:S6539", // Monster class; RestContext is intentionally a central hub for REST framework configuration
161   "resource" // Streams and session objects returned to callers; lifecycle managed by the servlet container or RestCall
162})
163public class RestContext extends Context {
164
165   private static final RichLogger LOG = RichLogger.getLogger(RestContext.class);
166
167   /**
168    * Bootstrap arguments for {@link RestContext}.
169    *
170    * <p>
171    * Bundles the small, fixed set of inputs needed to construct a {@link RestContext} into a single immutable record.
172    *
173    * <p>
174    * All non-required values default sensibly:
175    * <ul>
176    *    <li>{@code parentContext}, {@code servletConfig} — {@code null} (top-level resource, no servlet container)
177    *    <li>{@code path} — {@code ""} (no path prefix)
178    *    <li>{@code beanStoreConfigurer} — no-op (no pre-build bean-store mutation)
179    *    <li>{@code overridingParent} — {@code null} (no test-time override layer)
180    * </ul>
181    *
182    * <p>
183    * The {@code beanStoreConfigurer} hook gives test fixtures and integration code a chance to register beans on
184    * the {@link WritableBeanStore} after the resource has been wired in but before the
185    * {@code findXxx()} memoizers fire.
186    *
187    * <p>
188    * The {@code overridingParent} hook installs a {@link BeanStore} into the {@code overridingParent} slot of the
189    * freshly-constructed {@link BasicBeanStore} so that test-time overrides resolve at tier 1 of the lookup chain
190    * (above the resource's local {@code @Bean} factory entries and the Spring bridge).  This is the
191    * canonical Mode INJECT wiring point for {@code juneau-junit5}'s {@code TestBeanStore}.
192    *
193    * <h2 class='section'>Example:</h2>
194    * <p class='bjava'>
195    *    <jk>var</jk> <jv>ctx</jv> = <jk>new</jk> RestContext(<jk>new</jk> RestContext.Args(MyResource.<jk>class</jk>, () -&gt; <jk>new</jk> MyResource()));
196    * </p>
197    *
198    * @param resourceClass The {@link Rest @Rest}-annotated REST resource class. Must not be {@code null}.
199    * @param parentContext The parent {@link RestContext}, or {@code null} if this is a top-level resource.
200    * @param servletConfig The {@link ServletConfig} from the servlet container, or {@code null} when none is available.
201    * @param resource The supplier that provides the resource instance during initialization. Must not be {@code null}.
202    * @param path The path prefix relative to the parent. Defaults to {@code ""}.
203    * @param beanStoreConfigurer A pre-build hook that runs against the resolved {@link WritableBeanStore}
204    *    after the resource has been wired in but before any {@code findXxx()} memoizer fires. Defaults to a no-op.
205    * @param overridingParent An optional test-time override layer installed into the {@code overridingParent}
206    *    slot of the freshly-constructed {@link BasicBeanStore}.  May be {@code null}.  Honored only when the
207    *    resource does <i>not</i> declare an {@code @Bean WritableBeanStore} factory method; user-supplied bean
208    *    stores are passed through unchanged.
209    * @param paths An optional programmatic override for the top-level mount-paths array (the highest-priority
210    *    rung in the runtime-override chain documented on {@link RestContext#getPaths()}).  {@code null} (the
211    *    default) means &quot;no programmatic override&quot; &mdash; resolution falls through to the resource's
212    *    {@code getPaths()} getter, then {@link Rest#paths()} (SVL-resolved per element and comma-split).
213    *    An empty array explicitly clears the mount list (no top-level mounts).
214    * @param kind The build-time {@link ContextKind kind} of this context — {@link ContextKind#ROOT ROOT} for a
215    *    top-level/host/mock resource, a {@link ContextKind.Child CHILD} carrying the {@link ResolvedChild} for a
216    *    {@link Rest#children() @Rest(children)}/{@link Rest#childrenDefs() childrenDefs} sub-resource (isolated
217    *    resolution, with an optional host-seeded payload), or a {@link ContextKind.Mixin MIXIN} carrying the
218    *    {@link ResolvedMixin} that produced a per-mixin sub-context (parent-linked to the host so that
219    *    {@link RestContext#getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String) annotation-property walks} prepend the host's
220    *    {@code @Rest} chain before the mixin's own).
221    *
222    * @since 10.0.0
223    */
224   @SuppressWarnings({
225      "java:S6218" // Args is a transient constructor-parameter holder; it is never compared for equality or used as a map key, so array-identity semantics on the paths[] component are irrelevant.
226   })
227   public static record Args(
228      Class<?> resourceClass,
229      RestContext parentContext,
230      ServletConfig servletConfig,
231      Supplier<?> resource,
232      String path,
233      Consumer<WritableBeanStore> beanStoreConfigurer,
234      BeanStore overridingParent,
235      String[] paths,
236      ContextKind kind,
237      RestBuilder<?> restBuilder
238   ) {
239
240      /**
241       * Compact canonical constructor — null-coalesces optional fields and validates required ones.
242       */
243      public Args {
244         reqnn("resourceClass", resourceClass);
245         reqnn("resource", resource);
246         if (path == null)
247            path = "";
248         if (beanStoreConfigurer == null)
249            beanStoreConfigurer = bs -> {};
250         if (kind == null)
251            kind = ContextKind.ROOT;
252      }
253
254      /**
255       * Back-compatible constructor without the {@code restBuilder} component (defaults it to <jk>null</jk>).
256       *
257       * <p>
258       * The {@code restBuilder} is then resolved during {@link RestContext} construction from the
259       * resource instance's stashed builder, so call sites that don't carry one keep working unchanged.
260       *
261       * @param resourceClass The resource class.
262       * @param parentContext The parent context, or <jk>null</jk>.
263       * @param servletConfig The servlet config, or <jk>null</jk>.
264       * @param resource The resource supplier.
265       * @param path The mount path override, or <jk>null</jk>.
266       * @param beanStoreConfigurer The bean-store configurer, or <jk>null</jk>.
267       * @param overridingParent The overriding parent bean store, or <jk>null</jk>.
268       * @param paths The programmatic mount-paths override, or <jk>null</jk>.
269       * @param kind The build-time {@link ContextKind kind} of this context, or <jk>null</jk> for {@link ContextKind#ROOT}.
270       */
271      public Args(Class<?> resourceClass, RestContext parentContext, ServletConfig servletConfig, Supplier<?> resource, String path, Consumer<WritableBeanStore> beanStoreConfigurer, BeanStore overridingParent, String[] paths, ContextKind kind) {
272         this(resourceClass, parentContext, servletConfig, resource, path, beanStoreConfigurer, overridingParent, paths, kind, null);
273      }
274
275      /**
276       * Returns {@code true} when this context is a per-mixin sub-context (its {@link #kind()} is a
277       * {@link ContextKind.Mixin}).
278       *
279       * @return {@code true} for a mixin sub-context.
280       */
281      public boolean isMixinContext() {
282         return kind instanceof ContextKind.Mixin;
283      }
284   }
285
286   /**
287    * The discovery-time normalized declaration of a single mixin.
288    *
289    * <p>
290    * Every mixin entry &mdash; whether a bare {@link Rest#mixins() Class&lt;?&gt;} or a rich
291    * {@link Rest#mixinDefs() &#64;Mixin} &mdash; is normalized to one of these immutable carriers at discovery
292    * time, so all downstream code consumes a single shape with no bare-vs-def branching.  A bare class is
293    * normalized to {@code new ResolvedMixin(type, MixinAnnotation.DEFAULT)} (i.e. {@code @Mixin(type=X)} with
294    * empty overrides), so a bare class and an empty-override {@code @Mixin} are structurally identical.
295    *
296    * <p>
297    * The {@code overrides} annotation is the single home for the host-declared override payload (guards,
298    * serializers, default headers, {@code path}/{@code paths}, {@code noInherit}, &hellip;).  For bare classes
299    * it is {@link MixinAnnotation#DEFAULT} (all slots empty), which contributes nothing &mdash; so bare-class
300    * mixins behave exactly as they did before the {@code @Mixin} feature.
301    *
302    * @param type The mixin class.
303    * @param overrides The host-declared override annotation, or {@link MixinAnnotation#DEFAULT} for a bare class.
304    *
305    * @since 10.0.0
306    */
307   public static record ResolvedMixin(Class<?> type, Mixin overrides) {
308
309      /**
310       * Compact canonical constructor — validates required components and null-coalesces {@code overrides}.
311       */
312      public ResolvedMixin {
313         reqnn("type", type);
314         if (overrides == null)
315            overrides = MixinAnnotation.DEFAULT;
316      }
317
318      /**
319       * Normalizes a bare mixin class to a {@link ResolvedMixin} with no overrides.
320       *
321       * @param type The mixin class.
322       * @return A {@link ResolvedMixin} carrying {@link MixinAnnotation#DEFAULT} overrides.
323       */
324      static ResolvedMixin ofBare(Class<?> type) {
325         return new ResolvedMixin(type, MixinAnnotation.DEFAULT);
326      }
327
328      /**
329       * Normalizes a rich {@code @Mixin} declaration to a {@link ResolvedMixin}.
330       *
331       * @param m The {@code @Mixin} annotation.
332       * @return A {@link ResolvedMixin} carrying {@code m} as its override payload.
333       */
334      static ResolvedMixin ofDef(Mixin m) {
335         return new ResolvedMixin(m.type(), m);
336      }
337
338      /**
339       * Returns {@code true} when this mixin carries no host-declared overrides (i.e. is equivalent to a bare class).
340       *
341       * @return {@code true} if the override payload is {@link MixinAnnotation#DEFAULT}.
342       */
343      boolean hasNoOverrides() {
344         return overrides == MixinAnnotation.DEFAULT;
345      }
346   }
347
348   /**
349    * Normalized carrier for a routed child, produced by discovery from either a bare {@link Rest#children()}
350    * class or a rich {@link Rest#childrenDefs() @Child} declaration — the exact structural analog of
351    * {@link ResolvedMixin}.
352    *
353    * <p>
354    * A bare class is normalized to {@code new ResolvedChild(type, ChildAnnotation.DEFAULT)} (i.e.
355    * {@code @Child(type=X)} with an empty seed), so a bare class and an empty-seed {@code @Child} are
356    * structurally identical — the same equivalence {@link ResolvedMixin} establishes for mixins.
357    *
358    * @param type The child class.
359    * @param seed The host-declared seed annotation, or {@link ChildAnnotation#DEFAULT} for a bare class.
360    *
361    * @since 10.0.0
362    */
363   public static record ResolvedChild(Class<?> type, Child seed) {
364
365      /**
366       * Compact canonical constructor — validates required components and null-coalesces {@code seed}.
367       */
368      public ResolvedChild {
369         reqnn("type", type);
370         if (seed == null)
371            seed = ChildAnnotation.DEFAULT;
372      }
373
374      /**
375       * Normalizes a bare child class to a {@link ResolvedChild} with no seed.
376       *
377       * @param type The child class.
378       * @return A {@link ResolvedChild} carrying {@link ChildAnnotation#DEFAULT} as its seed.
379       */
380      static ResolvedChild ofBare(Class<?> type) {
381         return new ResolvedChild(type, ChildAnnotation.DEFAULT);
382      }
383
384      /**
385       * Normalizes a rich {@code @Child} declaration to a {@link ResolvedChild}.
386       *
387       * @param c The {@code @Child} annotation.
388       * @return A {@link ResolvedChild} carrying {@code c} as its seed.
389       */
390      static ResolvedChild ofDef(Child c) {
391         return new ResolvedChild(c.type(), c);
392      }
393
394      /**
395       * Returns {@code true} when this child carries no host-declared seed (i.e. is equivalent to a bare class).
396       *
397       * @return {@code true} if the seed payload is {@link ChildAnnotation#DEFAULT}.
398       */
399      boolean hasNoSeed() {
400         return seed == ChildAnnotation.DEFAULT;
401      }
402   }
403
404   /**
405    * The build-time <i>kind</i> of a {@link RestContext} — which of the three construction flavors produced it.
406    *
407    * <p>
408    * Replaces the former boolean {@code mixinContext} flag on {@link Args} with a typed discriminator so the
409    * three flavors are explicit and self-documenting at every call site, and so the {@code MIXIN} flavor can
410    * carry the {@link ResolvedMixin} that produced it (the single home for the host-declared override payload,
411    * consumed at build time when the mixin sub-context resolves its settings).
412    *
413    * <p>
414    * <b>Mixin vs. child asymmetry (important — do not assume symmetry):</b> a {@link Mixin} sub-context is
415    * parent-linked to the host and <i>inherits</i> the host's {@code @Rest} annotation chain
416    * ({@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)} walks host&rarr;mixin), so {@code @Mixin} overrides
417    * <i>layer on top of</i> an inherited chain.  A {@link Child} is <i>isolated</i> ({@link #HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES}
418    * includes {@code "children"}; children retain pre-10.0.0 isolated resolution with
419    * no parent walk).  A {@code @Child} seed therefore does not <i>override</i> an inherited chain the way a
420    * {@code @Mixin} override does — instead, {@link #computeRawRestAnnotations()} injects the seed's synthetic
421    * {@code @Rest} at the <b>least-derived</b> slot of the child's own (still fully isolated) annotation chain,
422    * between the child's real {@code @Rest} declarations and the synthesized {@link
423    * org.apache.juneau.rest.server.config.DefaultConfig DefaultConfig} fallback.  This ranks the seed below
424    * everything the child itself declares (so the child's own explicit value wins for child-wins scalars, and
425    * the child's own {@code noInherit} cutoff naturally cuts the seed too) but above the framework defaults.
426    *
427    * @since 10.0.0
428    */
429   public sealed interface ContextKind permits ContextKind.Root, ContextKind.Child, ContextKind.Mixin {
430
431      /** A top-level (host) resource, mock context, or servlet-mounted resource. */
432      record Root() implements ContextKind {}
433
434      /**
435       * A routed child resource (mounted via {@link Rest#children()}/{@link Rest#childrenDefs()}); isolated
436       * resolution, with an optional host-seeded {@code @Child} payload injected at the least-derived slot of
437       * its own annotation chain (see the class javadoc above).
438       *
439       * @param def The normalized declaration that produced this sub-context — carries the host-declared seed payload.
440       */
441      record Child(ResolvedChild def) implements ContextKind {}
442
443      /**
444       * A per-mixin sub-context (composed via {@link Rest#mixins()}/{@link Rest#mixinDefs()}); inherits the host chain.
445       *
446       * @param def The normalized declaration that produced this sub-context — carries the host-declared override payload.
447       */
448      record Mixin(ResolvedMixin def) implements ContextKind {}
449
450      /** Shared {@link Root} singleton (the common case). */
451      ContextKind ROOT = new Root();
452   }
453
454   /**
455    * Builder class.
456    *
457    * <p>
458    * Demoted to package-private in the April 2026 refactor (2026-04-19). User code should construct a
459    * {@link RestContext} via the public {@link #RestContext(Args)} constructor; this Builder
460    * exists only as internal bootstrap state for the framework and is slated for inlining in a later phase.
461    */
462   @SuppressWarnings({
463      "rawtypes" // Raw types required: annotation type parameter is unknown at static analysis time.
464   })
465   static class Builder extends Context.Builder implements ServletConfig {
466
467      private final Class<?> resourceClass;
468      private final RestContext parentContext;
469      private final ServletConfig inner;
470      final Args args;
471
472      /**
473       * Programmatic top-level mount-paths override.
474       *
475       * <p>
476       * Highest-priority rung in the runtime-override chain documented on {@link RestContext#getPaths()}.
477       * Set via {@link #paths(String...)}.
478       *
479       * <ul>
480       *    <li>{@code null} (default) &mdash; no programmatic override; falls through to the resource's
481       *       {@code getPaths()} getter, then the {@code @Rest(paths=...)} annotation default (SVL-resolved
482       *       per element and comma-split).
483       *    <li>Empty array &mdash; explicit clear; resource is resolved with no top-level mounts.
484       *    <li>Non-empty array &mdash; replaces all lower rungs.
485       * </ul>
486       */
487      String[] paths;
488
489      /**
490       * Programmatic override for the MDC async propagation flag.
491       *
492       * <p>
493       * {@code null} (default) &mdash; defers to the {@code RestContext.mdcAsyncPropagation} env-driven
494       * default (itself defaulting to {@code true} when SLF4J is detected). Set via
495       * {@link #mdcAsyncPropagation(boolean)}.
496       */
497      Boolean mdcAsyncPropagation;
498
499      /**
500       * Programmatic override for the async-completion executor bean name.
501       *
502       * <p>
503       * {@code null} (default) &mdash; resolved from the {@code @Rest(asyncCompletionExecutor)} annotation chain.
504       * Set via {@link #asyncCompletionExecutor(String)} to supply the bean-name programmatically (useful in
505       * test rigs that construct a {@link RestContext} directly without annotations).
506       */
507      String asyncCompletionExecutorName;
508
509      /**
510       * Programmatic override for the lazy-children flag.
511       *
512       * <p>

685   /**
686    * Resolves the top-level mount paths for a resource using the runtime-override chain.
687    *
688    * <p>
689    * Walks the three rungs in precedence order (highest first):
690    * <ol>
691    *    <li>Programmatic override on {@link Builder#paths} (set by {@link Builder#paths(String...)} or seeded from
692    *       {@link Args#paths()}).
693    *    <li>The resource's {@code getPaths()} getter (when non-{@code null}).
694    *    <li>{@link Rest#paths() @Rest(paths)} annotation default, walked top-down with the most-derived non-empty
695    *       array winning.  Each element is SVL-resolved against a session of {@code vr} backed by
696    *       {@code beanStore} (so {@code ${C:key}} consults whatever {@link Config} is registered), then
697    *       comma-split.
698    * </ol>
699    *
700    * @return The resolved paths array (never {@code null}; possibly empty).
701    */
702   private static String[] resolveMountPaths(Builder builder, Object resource, VarResolver vr, WritableBeanStore beanStore, List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>> annotations) {
703      // Rung 1: programmatic override (Builder.paths / Args.paths).
704      var programmatic = builder.paths;
705      if (programmatic != null)
706         return cp(programmatic);
707      return resolvePathsCore(annotations, resource, vr, beanStore);
708   }

710   /**
711    * Public mount-time path resolver for use by hosting runtimes that mount {@code @Rest}-annotated resources
712    * before the {@link RestContext} has been constructed (e.g. {@code JettyServerComponent}'s auto-discovery
713    * loop, or Spring Boot's {@code ServletRegistrationBean} wiring).
714    *
715    * <p>
716    * Operates on the same chain as {@link RestContext#getPaths()} but skips the programmatic Builder rung
717    * (which is only meaningful inside the {@link RestContext} constructor):
718    * <ol>
719    *    <li>The resource's {@code getPaths()} virtual getter (defined on {@code RestServlet} /
720    *       {@code RestResource}). {@code null} return falls through; non-{@code null} (including empty array) wins.
721    *    <li>{@link Rest#paths() @Rest(paths)} annotation default on the most-derived class, SVL-resolved per
722    *       element and comma-split.  A {@code VarResolver} is looked up on {@code store} (when present); SVL
723    *       variables like {@code ${C:key}} resolve against beans visible to the bean store.
724    * </ol>
725    *
726    * @param resourceClass The {@code @Rest}-annotated resource class. Must not be {@code null}.
727    * @param resource The resource instance. May be {@code null} (in which case the getter rung is skipped).
728    * @param store The bean store used to look up the {@link VarResolver} for SVL substitution on annotation
729    *    elements, and to back the resolver session for bean-driven SVL vars like {@code ${C:key}}. May be
730    *    {@code null} (SVL is then skipped; literals pass through unchanged).
731    * @return The resolved paths array (never {@code null}; possibly empty).
732    * @since 10.0.0
733    */
734   public static String[] resolveTopLevelPaths(Class<?> resourceClass, Object resource, BeanStore store) {
735      var ap = AnnotationProvider.INSTANCE;
736      var ci = ClassInfo.of(resourceClass);
737      var annotations = rstream(ap.find(Rest.class, ci)).toList();
738      var vr = (store == null) ? null : store.getBean(VarResolver.class).orElse(null);
739      // Cast for the bean-store-backed resolver session only — when store is a plain BeanStore (not
740      // WritableBeanStore) we skip the session form and call vr.resolve(...) directly.
741      var ws = (store instanceof WritableBeanStore store2) ? store2 : null;
742      return resolvePathsCore(annotations, resource, vr, ws);
743   }
744
745   private static String[] resolvePathsCore(List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>> annotations, Object resource, VarResolver vr, WritableBeanStore beanStore) {
746      // Rung 2: getPaths() virtual getter on the resource (RestServlet / RestResource / any matching class).
747      // The getter return is normalized to a flat List<String> of raw leaves (any String / String[] /
748      // Collection / Iterable / Stream / nested mix of those), then each leaf flows through the same
749      // SVL-resolve + comma-split pipeline used for @Rest(paths=...) annotation elements.
750      var raw = invokeGetPaths(resource);
751      if (raw != null) {
752         var leaves = normalizePaths(raw);
753         return expandPathsElements(leaves.toArray(new String[0]), vr, beanStore);
754      }
755
756      // Rung 3: @Rest(paths) annotation default — most-derived non-empty array wins, with each element
757      // SVL-resolved then comma-split (trim each piece, drop empties).  A single template element can
758      // therefore expand to zero, one, or many mount paths.  Annotation arrays from javac are never
759      // null, so the only filter needed is the empty-array case.
760      return annotations.stream()
761         .map(ai -> ai.inner().paths())
762         .filter(arr -> arr.length > 0)
763         .findFirst()
764         .map(arr -> expandPathsElements(arr, vr, beanStore))
765         .orElseGet(() -> new String[0]);
766   }
767
768   /**
769    * Applies the per-element SVL + comma-split pipeline to a {@code @Rest(paths=...)} array.
770    *
771    * <p>
772    * Each input element is SVL-resolved (via a session of the bootstrap {@link VarResolver} that's backed
773    * by {@code beanStore} when one is available, so bean-driven vars like {@code ${C:key}} can find the
774    * registered {@link Config}), then split on {@code ,}; each piece is trimmed and empty pieces are
775    * dropped.  This lets a single element like {@code "${C:health.paths}"} or
776    * {@code "${E:HEALTH_PATHS:/healthz,/readyz}"} expand to multiple mount paths.
777    */
778   private static String[] expandPathsElements(String[] elements, VarResolver vr, WritableBeanStore beanStore) {
779      // Open a single session for the whole array — reusing it across elements avoids re-walking the
780      // Var catalog and lets ConfigVar / FileVar / etc. all share one bean-lookup context.
781      var session = (vr == null) ? null : vr.createSession(beanStore);
782      var out = new ArrayList<String>(elements.length);
783      for (var e : elements) {
784         var resolved = applySvl(e, session);
785         splitPathsValue(resolved, out);
786      }
787      return out.toArray(new String[0]);
788   }
789
790   private static String applySvl(String value, VarResolverSession session) {
791      // Callers only pass annotation-array elements, which javac guarantees non-null.  An empty string
792      // has no SVL markers to resolve, so we short-circuit it (avoids a pointless session.resolve call).
793      if (session == null || value.isEmpty())
794         return value;
795      try {
796         return session.resolve(value);
797      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
798         return value; // SVL failure: prefer the literal over throwing during construction.
799      }
800   }
801
802   private static void splitPathsValue(String value, List<String> out) {
803      // Callers pass the return of applySvl, which never returns null (we control both branches above).
804      if (value.isBlank())
805         return;
806      var parts = value.split(",");
807      for (var p : parts) {
808         var t = p.trim();
809         if (! t.isEmpty())
810            out.add(t);
811      }
812   }
813
814   /**
815    * Flattens any {@link Object} returned from {@code getPaths()} (String, {@code String[]},
816    * {@link Collection}, {@link Iterable}, {@link Stream}, primitive array, or nested mixes of these)
817    * into a flat {@link List} of raw leaf strings.
818    *
819    * <p>
820    * Non-{@link String} leaves are coerced via {@link String#valueOf(Object)}.  The returned list
821    * preserves traversal order; {@code null} leaves are dropped.  Comma-split + SVL resolution are
822    * intentionally <i>not</i> applied here &mdash; they happen downstream in
823    * {@link #expandPathsElements(String[], VarResolver, WritableBeanStore)} so SVL substitution sees the
824    * raw element (preserving {@code ${E:NAME:defaultWithCommas}}-style defaults) before the post-SVL
825    * comma-split fires.
826    */
827   private static List<String> normalizePaths(Object o) {
828      if (o == null)
829         return List.of();
830      var out = new ArrayList<String>();
831      CollectionUtils.<Object>accumulate(o).forEach(x -> {
832         if (x != null)
833            out.add(String.valueOf(x));
834      });
835      return out;
836   }

838   /**
839    * Reflectively invokes a no-arg {@code getPaths()} method on the resource (defined on
840    * {@link RestServlet RestServlet} and
841    * {@link RestResource RestResource}). Reflection is used to avoid coupling this
842    * static utility to either base class &mdash; if a custom {@code @Rest}-annotated POJO declares
843    * {@code public Object getPaths()} (or any covariant return type such as {@code String[]},
844    * {@code List<String>}, etc.), it participates uniformly.
845    *
846    * @return The raw getter return value, or {@code null} when no method exists, the method returns
847    *    {@code void}, the method returned {@code null}, or reflective invocation failed.
848    */
849   private static Object invokeGetPaths(Object resource) {
850      if (resource == null)
851         return null;
852      Method m;
853      try {
854         m = resource.getClass().getMethod("getPaths");
855      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") NoSuchMethodException e) {
856         return null;
857      }
858      if (m.getReturnType() == void.class)
859         return null;
860      try {
861         return m.invoke(resource);
862      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") IllegalAccessException | InvocationTargetException e) {
863         return null;
864      }
865   }

873   private static boolean isBeanMethod(MethodInfo mi, String name) {
874      return mi.getAnnotations(Bean.class)

876         .findFirst()
877         .filter(x -> x.methodScope().length == 0 && (n(name) || eq(BeanAnnotation.name(x), name)))
878         .isPresent();
879   }

947   /**
948    * Creates the bean store for this context.
949    *
950    * <p>
951    * The 10.0 precedence model places the parent (Spring or parent-resource bootstrap) as the
952    * overriding parent so it wins over local entries.  Memoizer-backed framework defaults are
953    * registered later in the constructor via {@code addDefaultSupplier}, putting them at the
954    * bottom of the resolution order.
955    *
956    * <p>
957    * Resolution:
958    * <ol>
959    *    <li>If the resource declares an {@code @Bean} factory method returning a
960    *       {@link WritableBeanStore} (e.g. {@code SpringRestServlet.createBeanStore(Optional<BeanStore>)}),
961    *       that store is used directly.  Spring integration relies on this hook.
962    *    <li>Otherwise a fresh {@link BasicBeanStore} is created with {@code parentBs} as its
963    *       regular parent and {@code overridingParent} (if non-{@code null}) installed in the
964    *       overriding-parent slot so test-time overrides win over local entries.
965    * </ol>
966    *
967    * @param parentBs
968    *    The parent (bootstrap) bean store to layer onto, or {@code null} for root resources.
969    * @param resource
970    *    The REST servlet/bean instance that this context is defined against.
971    * @param overridingParent
972    *    Optional test-time override layer for the {@code overridingParent} slot of the freshly-constructed
973    *    {@link BasicBeanStore}.  May be {@code null}.  Ignored when the resource supplies its own
974    *    {@link WritableBeanStore} via an {@code @Bean} factory method &mdash; user-supplied stores are
975    *    passed through unchanged.
976    * @return The bean store for this context.
977    */
978   private WritableBeanStore createBeanStore(BeanStore parentBs, Supplier<?> resource, BeanStore overridingParent) {
979      var defaultBs = new BasicBeanStore(parentBs, overridingParent);
980      return defaultBs.createBeanFromMethod(WritableBeanStore.class, resource.get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod)
981         .orElse(defaultBs);
982   }

989    * Bean-store types and framework-managed types (see {@link #isFrameworkBeanType(Class, String)}, such as
990    * {@link SerializerSet} or {@link MethodExecStore}) are excluded so that each child keeps its own instances.
991    * This holds for named beans too: a {@code @Bean(name="encoders") EncoderSet} is not exported.
992    *

997   private boolean isInheritableBeanType(Class<?> type, String name) {

999         return false;

1009    * registration walk (the framework memoizer invokes them) and are never exported to children.

1013    * @return {@code true} if the type is framework-managed.
1014    */
1015   private boolean isFrameworkBeanType(Class<?> type, String name) {
1016      return beanStore.hasDefaultSupplier(type, name) || beanStore.hasDefaultSupplier(type, "");

1022   /**
1023    * Returns {@code true} when this context is a per-mixin sub-context constructed by the host's
1024    * {@code restOperations} memoizer.
1025    *
1026    * <p>
1027    * A mixin sub-context is parent-linked to the host's {@link RestContext} so that
1028    * {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String) annotation-property walks} prepend the host's {@code @Rest}
1029    * chain before the mixin's own &mdash; serializers, parsers, encoders, converters, response processors,
1030    * REST op args, guards, restDebugFormatter, messages, and varResolver tokens all inherit from the
1031    * host first, with the mixin's contributions appended.  Use {@link Rest#noInherit() @Rest(noInherit)} on the
1032    * mixin class to cut off inheritance for any specific property.
1033    *
1034    * <p>
1035    * {@link Rest#children() @Rest(children)} sub-resources are <i>not</i> mixin contexts &mdash; they retain
1036    * pre-10.0.0 isolated resolution (no parent-context walk), and inherit only the parent's
1037    * {@link #getInheritableBeanStore() non-framework beans}.  The mixin-vs-child divergence is intentional:
1038    * mixins are inline composers that share the host's URL namespace; children are heavyweight independent
1039    * resources mounted at their own URL prefix.
1040    *
1041    * @return {@code true} if this is a mixin sub-context, {@code false} for top-level resources and child
1042    *    resources.
1043    * @since 10.0.0
1044    */
1045   public boolean isMixinContext() { return isMixinContext; }

1060   /**
1061    * Registers memoizer-backed default suppliers for every framework-managed bean type on the supplied
1062    * bean store.
1063    *
1064    * <p>
1065    * Default suppliers sit at the bottom of the bean-store resolution order: they fire only when no
1066    * {@link Bean @Bean} method, no programmatic {@code addBean(...)} call, and no Spring/overriding-parent
1067    * binding has been registered for the type.  This is the mechanism that replaces the old
1068    * {@code DELAYED_INJECTION} list — by registering the framework's own factories as defaults
1069    * <i>before</i> the {@link Bean @Bean} method walk runs, any {@link Bean @Bean} method whose parameters
1070    * include framework types can now resolve those parameters lazily through the bean store without
1071    * requiring a hand-maintained skip list.
1072    */
1073   private void registerFrameworkDefaults(WritableBeanStore bs) {
1074      // @formatter:off
1075      // Unnamed framework types backed by per-resource memoizers.
1076      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MarshallingContext.class, marshallingContext::get);
1077      bs.addDefaultSupplier(EncoderSet.class, encoders::get);
1078      bs.addDefaultSupplier(SerializerSet.class, serializers::get);
1079      bs.addDefaultSupplier(ParserSet.class, parsers::get);
1080      bs.addDefaultSupplier(RichLogger.class, logger::get);
1081      bs.addDefaultSupplier(java.util.logging.Logger.class, logger::get);
1082      bs.addDefaultSupplier(ThrownStore.class, thrownStore::get);
1083      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodExecStore.class, methodExecStore::get);
1084      bs.addDefaultSupplier(Messages.class, messages::get);
1085      bs.addDefaultSupplier(VarResolver.class, varResolver::get);
1086      bs.addDefaultSupplier(Config.class, config::get);
1087      bs.addDefaultSupplier(ResponseProcessor[].class, responseProcessors::get);
1088      bs.addDefaultSupplier(RestDebugFormatter.class, restDebugFormatter::get);
1089      bs.addDefaultSupplier(HttpPartSerializer.class, partSerializer::get);
1090      bs.addDefaultSupplier(HttpPartParser.class, partParser::get);
1091      bs.addDefaultSupplier(JsonSchemaGenerator.class, jsonSchemaGenerator::get);
1092      bs.addDefaultSupplier(StaticFiles.class, staticFiles::get);
1093      bs.addDefaultSupplier(FileFinder.class, staticFiles::get);
1094      bs.addDefaultSupplier(SwaggerProvider.class, swaggerProvider::get);
1095      bs.addDefaultSupplier(OpenApiProvider.class, openApiProvider::get);
1096      bs.addDefaultSupplier(RestOperations.class, restOperations::get);
1097      bs.addDefaultSupplier(RestChildren.class, restChildren::get);
1098      // Named framework beans (replaces DELAYED_INJECTION_NAMES).
1099      bs.addDefaultSupplier(VarResolver.class, this::getBootstrapVarResolver, "bootstrapVarResolver");
1100      bs.addDefaultSupplier(HttpHeaderList.class, defaultRequestHeaders::get, "defaultRequestHeaders");
1101      bs.addDefaultSupplier(HttpHeaderList.class, defaultResponseHeaders::get, "defaultResponseHeaders");
1102      bs.addDefaultSupplier(NamedAttributeMap.class, defaultRequestAttributes::get, "defaultRequestAttributes");
1103      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, () -> destroyInvokerPair.get().methods, "destroyMethods");
1104      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, () -> endCallInvokerPair.get().methods, "endCallMethods");
1105      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, postCallMethods::get, "postCallMethods");
1106      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, () -> postInitChildFirstInvokerPair.get().methods, "postInitChildFirstMethods");
1107      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, () -> postInitInvokerPair.get().methods, "postInitMethods");
1108      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, preCallMethods::get, "preCallMethods");
1109      bs.addDefaultSupplier(MethodList.class, () -> startCallInvokerPair.get().methods, "startCallMethods");
1110      // @formatter:on
1111   }

1113   /**
1114    * Registers a {@link PropertySource} bean named {@code "rest.config"} in this resource's
1115    * {@code BeanStore} so that {@code @Value("${cfg-key}")} fields on the resource bean (and on
1116    * request-scoped beans whose {@code BeanStore} parent-walks to this one) resolve against the
1117    * resource's {@code @Rest(config=...)} {@link Config}(s).
1118    *
1119    * <p>
1120    * Lookup order honored by the registered source:
1121    * <ol>
1122    *    <li>The child class's resolved {@link Config} &mdash; sourced from {@link #rawConfig} so that
1123    *       any {@link Bean @Bean Config} factory-method override on the resource bean is preserved.
1124    *    <li>Any additional, distinct {@code @Rest(config=...)} {@code Config}s declared on parent
1125    *       classes (child-to-parent order, dedup'd by resolved file name). Child keys win on
1126    *       collision; parent keys fill the gaps.
1127    * </ol>
1128    *
1129    * <p>
1130    * Critically, this registration lives on the per-resource {@code BeanStore} &mdash; <i>not</i> on
1131    * the process-wide {@code Settings.get()} singleton. The static {@code RestContext} cache in
1132    * {@code MockRestClient} (and any other long-lived cache) is therefore benign: leaked
1133    * {@code RestContext}s carry their {@code PropertySource}s in their own {@code BeanStore}s.
1134    * The global {@code Settings} source list does not grow, and {@code Settings.get(name)}'s
1135    * reverse-order walk stays O(constant).
1136    */
1137   private void registerRestConfigPropertySources() {
1138      var sources = collectRestConfigPropertySources();
1139      if (sources.isEmpty())
1140         return;
1141      final List<PropertySource> chain = List.copyOf(sources);
1142      PropertySource src;
1143      if (chain.size() == 1) {
1144         src = chain.get(0);
1145      } else {
1146         src = name -> {
1147            for (var s : chain) {
1148               var r = s.get(name);
1149               if (r.isPresent())
1150                  return r;
1151            }
1152            return PropertyLookupResult.missing();
1153         };
1154      }
1155      beanStore.addBean(PropertySource.class, src, "rest.config");
1156   }
1157
1158   /**
1159    * Walks the {@code @Rest(config=...)} annotation chain (child-first) and builds a
1160    * {@link ConfigPropertySource} for each distinct, non-empty config attribute.
1161    *
1162    * <p>
1163    * The first (most-derived) slot reuses {@code rawConfig.get()} so that any {@link Bean @Bean}
1164    * {@code Config} factory-method override on the resource bean is preserved &mdash; the rest of
1165    * the framework already sees that exact instance via {@link #getConfig()} and {@code @RestInit}
1166    * parameter resolution. Parent slots load via {@code Config.create().name(...)} since {@code @Bean}
1167    * overrides apply to the most-derived class only.
1168    *
1169    * <p>
1170    * Edge case: a resource with no {@code @Rest(config=...)} annotation but with a {@link Bean @Bean}
1171    * {@code Config} factory method has a non-null {@code rawConfig.get()} and no annotation-driven
1172    * slot. That single {@code rawConfig} is still registered so user-supplied {@code Config}s flow
1173    * through to {@code @Value} resolution.
1174    */
1175   @SuppressWarnings({
1176      "java:S135" // Per-annotation continue guards are clearer than restructuring the config-source filter chain.
1177   })
1178   private List<PropertySource> collectRestConfigPropertySources() {
1179      var bs = beanStore();
1180      var vr = bs.getBean(VarResolver.class, "bootstrapVarResolver").orElseGet(this::getBootstrapVarResolver);
1181      var result = new ArrayList<PropertySource>();
1182      var seen = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
1183      // AnnotationProvider returns child-first; iterate in the same order so child wins on collision.
1184      var anns = AnnotationProvider.INSTANCE.find(Rest.class, info(resourceClass));
1185      for (var i = 0; i < anns.size(); i++) {
1186         var raw = anns.get(i).inner().config();
1187         if (isEmpty(raw))
1188            continue;
1189         var resolvedName = vr.resolve(raw);
1190         if (isEmpty(resolvedName))
1191            continue;
1192         if (! seen.add(resolvedName))
1193            continue;
1194         Config cfg;
1195         if (result.isEmpty()) {
1196            // Most-derived child slot. rawConfig.get() captures @Bean Config override; reuse it.
1197            cfg = rawConfig.get();
1198         } else if (eq(resolvedName, "SYSTEM_DEFAULT")) {
1199            cfg = Config.getSystemDefault();
1200         } else {
1201            cfg = Config.create().varResolver(vr).name(resolvedName).build();
1202         }
1203         if (cfg != null)
1204            result.add(new ConfigPropertySource(cfg));
1205      }
1206      // Edge case: no @Rest(config=...) annotation produced a slot, but rawConfig.get() is non-null
1207      // (e.g. a @Bean Config factory method without a matching @Rest(config=...) attribute, or the
1208      // SYSTEM_DEFAULT branch fired without an annotation). Still register rawConfig as the sole source.
1209      if (result.isEmpty()) {
1210         var rc = rawConfig.get();
1211         if (rc != null)
1212            result.add(new ConfigPropertySource(rc));
1213      }
1214      return result;
1215   }

1217   private static final class LifecycleInvokerPair {
1218      final MethodList methods;
1219      final MethodInvoker[] invokers;
1220
1221      LifecycleInvokerPair(MethodList methods, MethodInvoker[] invokers) {
1222         this.methods = methods;
1223         this.invokers = invokers;
1224      }
1225   }

1227   /**
1228    * The {@link MarshallingContext} for this resource.
1229    *
1230    * <p>
1231    * Triggered eagerly in the constructor after {@code annotationWork} is set, so that annotation
1232    * work is applied before the builder is used by any other memoizer.
1233    */
1234   private final Memoizer<MarshallingContext.Builder> beanContextBuilder = memoizer(() -> {
1235      var v = Holder.of(MarshallingContext.create());
1236      v.get().apply(annotationWork);
1237      return v.get();
1238   });
1239
1240   /**
1241    * The {@link MarshallingContext} for this resource.
1242    */
1243   private final Memoizer<MarshallingContext> marshallingContext = memoizer(() -> beanContextBuilder.get().build());
1244
1245   /**
1246    * The unresolved (bootstrap-time) {@link Config} for this resource.
1247    *
1248    * <p>
1249    * Resolved by reading {@code @Rest(config)} from the annotation chain against the bootstrap
1250    * {@link VarResolver} (which must already be in the bean store). Triggered eagerly in the constructor
1251    * so the raw config is registered before {@code @RestInit} hooks run.
1252    */
1253   private final Memoizer<Config> rawConfig = memoizer(() -> {
1254      var bs = beanStore();
1255      var v = Holder.<Config>empty();
1256      // Bootstrap VarResolver is registered under "bootstrapVarResolver" during construction; the
1257      // unnamed VarResolver slot is reserved for the full runtime resolver default supplier.
1258      var vr = bs.getBean(VarResolver.class, "bootstrapVarResolver").orElseGet(this::getBootstrapVarResolver);
1259      var cfv = Holder.<String>empty();
1260      rstream(AnnotationProvider.INSTANCE.find(Rest.class, info(resourceClass()))).map(x -> x.inner().config()).filter(Shorts::ine).forEach(x -> cfv.set(vr.resolve(x)));
1261      var cf = cfv.orElse("");
1262      if (v.isEmpty() && eq(cf, "SYSTEM_DEFAULT"))
1263         v.set(Config.getSystemDefault());
1264      if (v.isEmpty() && cf.isEmpty() && isMixinContextField() && getParentContext() != null)
1265         // Mixin sub-contexts with no own @Rest(config) inherit the host's raw Config, so that ${C:...}
1266         // SVL variables embedded in inherited class-level config (e.g. the @HtmlDocConfig theme/header/
1267         // footer declared via ${C:REST/...} on BasicRestConfig) resolve against the host's loaded config
1268         // rather than an empty one.  This mirrors the way messages and varResolver tokens already inherit
1269         // from the host for mixin sub-contexts.
1270         v.set(getParentContext().rawConfig.get());
1271      if (v.isEmpty()) {
1272         Config.Builder cb = Config.create().varResolver(vr);
1273         if (!cf.isEmpty())
1274            cb.name(cf);
1275         v.set(cb.build());
1276      }
1277      bs.createBeanFromMethod(Config.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod, v.get()).ifPresent(v::set);
1278      return v.get();
1279   });

1281   /**
1282    * The bootstrap-time {@link VarResolver} — no {@link Messages} or {@link Config} bean available yet.
1283    *
1284    * <p>
1285    * Builds the same {@link Var} catalog as the runtime resolver but without {@link Messages} or {@link Config}
1286    * beans wired in — those depend on settings that are themselves resolved against this resolver.
1287    * Triggered eagerly in the constructor so the result is available in the bean store before
1288    * {@link Config} and annotation work are initialized.
1289    */
1290   // @formatter:off
1291   private final Memoizer<VarResolver> bootstrapVarResolver = memoizer(() -> {
1292      var bs = beanStore();
1293      Holder<VarResolver> v = Holder.of(
1294         VarResolver.create()
1295            .defaultVars()
1296            .defaultFunctions()
1297            .vars(VarList.of(
1298               ConfigVar.class, FileVar.class, LocalizationVar.class,
1299               RequestAttributeVar.class, RequestFormDataVar.class, RequestHeaderVar.class,
1300               RequestPathVar.class, RequestQueryVar.class, RequestVar.class,
1301               RequestSwaggerVar.class, SerializedRequestAttrVar.class, ServletInitParamVar.class,
1302               SwaggerVar.class, OpenApiVar.class, UrlVar.class, UrlEncodeVar.class, HtmlWidgetVar.class
1303            ).addDefault())
1304            .bean(FileFinder.class, FileFinder.create(bs).cp(resourceClass(), null, true).build())
1305            .build()
1306      );
1307      bs.createBeanFromMethod(VarResolver.class, resource().get(), x -> isBeanMethod(x, "bootstrapVarResolver")).ifPresent(v::set);
1308      return v.get();
1309   });
1310   // @formatter:on

1312   /**
1313    * The default {@link RestDebugFormatter} for this resource.
1314    *
1315    * <p>
1316    * Defaults to {@link BasicRestDebugFormatter}. A bean-store override or {@code @Bean} factory method REPLACES the
1317    * result. (Resource-class-implements-the-SPI precedence is applied by {@link #getRestDebugFormatter()}, ahead of this
1318    * default supplier.)

1323      bs.getBeanType(RestDebugFormatter.class).ifPresent(creator::type);

1325      return creator.asOptional().orElse(null);
1326   });

1328   /**
1329    * The effective {@link RequestIdSettings} for this resource's always-on request-id resolver.
1330    *
1331    * <p>
1332    * Explicit three-rung resolution (highest precedence first):
1333    * <ol>
1334    *    <li>Registered bean &mdash; {@code beanStore().getBean(RequestIdSettings.class)}.
1335    *    <li>{@code @Bean} factory method on the resource.
1336    *    <li>The built-in defaults ({@link RequestIdSettings.Builder}: sanitize-and-accept validator, {@code "requestId"}
1337    *       attribute key, version-7 UUID supplier).
1338    * </ol>
1339    */

1341      var bs = beanStore();
1342      var bean = bs.getBean(RequestIdSettings.class).orElse(null);
1343      if (bean != null)
1344         return bean;
1345      var fromMethod = bs.createBeanFromMethod(RequestIdSettings.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod).orElse(null);
1346      if (fromMethod != null)
1347         return fromMethod;
1348      return RequestIdSettings.create().build();

1351   /**
1352    * The locally-resolved {@link RestAuthenticator} for this resource, if any.
1353    *
1354    * <p>
1355    * Resolution precedence (highest first):
1356    * <ol>
1357    *    <li>Registered bean &mdash; {@code beanStore().getBean(RestAuthenticator.class)}.
1358    *    <li>{@code @Rest(authenticator=X)} &mdash; instantiated via the bean store (constructor injection).
1359    *    <li>{@code @Bean} factory method on the resource.
1360    *    <li>{@link RestServlet#createAuthenticator(BeanStore)} override.
1361    * </ol>
1362    * The {@link RestAuthenticator.Null} sentinel is treated as &quot;unset.&quot;
1363    */
1364   private final Memoizer<Optional<RestAuthenticator>> localAuthenticator = memoizer(() -> {
1365      var bs = beanStore();
1366      var bean = bs.getBean(RestAuthenticator.class).orElse(null);
1367      if (bean != null)
1368         return o(bean);
1369      var annoClass = getRestAnnotationsForProperty("authenticator")
1370         .map(ai -> ai.inner().authenticator())
1371         .filter(x -> x != RestAuthenticator.Null.class)
1372         .reduce((first, second) -> second)
1373         .orElse(null);
1374      if (annoClass != null)
1375         return o(BeanInstantiator.of(RestAuthenticator.class, bs).type(annoClass).noBuilder().run());
1376      var fromMethod = bs.createBeanFromMethod(RestAuthenticator.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod).orElse(null);
1377      if (fromMethod != null)
1378         return o(fromMethod);
1379      if (resource().get() instanceof RestServlet rs) {
1380         var fromOverride = rs.createAuthenticator(bs);
1381         if (fromOverride != null)
1382            return o(fromOverride);
1383      }
1384      return Optional.<RestAuthenticator>empty();
1385   });

1387   /**
1388    * The effective root-to-this {@link RestAuthenticator} list, honoring {@code noInherit={"authenticator"}}.
1389    *
1390    * <p>
1391    * Unlike guards (which are child-isolated), authenticators inherit down the child-resource tree: the parent
1392    * context's effective list is prepended (root first), then this resource's local authenticator is appended.
1393    * A {@code @Rest(noInherit={"authenticator"})} on this resource cuts off the parent walk (subtree opt-out).
1394    */
1395   private final Memoizer<List<RestAuthenticator>> effectiveAuthenticators = memoizer(() -> {
1396      var l = new ArrayList<RestAuthenticator>();
1397      var pc = parentContext();
1398      if (isInherited("authenticator") && pc != null)
1399         l.addAll(pc.getEffectiveAuthenticators());
1400      localAuthenticator.get().ifPresent(l::add);
1401      return u(l);
1402   });

1404   /**
1405    * Returns the effective (root-to-this) authenticator chain for this resource.
1406    *
1407    * @return The effective authenticator chain, never <jk>null</jk>; may be empty.
1408    * @since 10.0.0
1409    */
1410   public List<RestAuthenticator> getEffectiveAuthenticators() {
1411      return effectiveAuthenticators.get();
1412   }

1414   /**
1415    * Runs the effective authenticator chain for this request, folding results and applying the resolved
1416    * principal/roles to the {@link RestRequest}.
1417    *
1418    * <p>
1419    * Invoked by {@link RestSession} before {@code preCall}.  When no authenticators are configured this is a
1420    * no-op (anonymous passthrough).  Each authenticator's {@link AuthenticationException} propagates to abort
1421    * the request with a {@code 401}.
1422    *
1423    * @param session The op session for this request.
1424    * @throws AuthenticationException If credentials are present but invalid.
1425    * @since 10.0.0
1426    */
1427   protected void authenticate(RestOpSession session) throws AuthenticationException {
1428      var auths = getEffectiveAuthenticators();
1429      if (auths.isEmpty())
1430         return;
1431      var req = session.getRequest();
1432      var acc = new AuthResultAccumulator();
1433      // Seed the fold with any pre-existing identity (container security or a servlet-layer AuthFilterChain) so
1434      // roles-only ADD results from resource authenticators augment it instead of being dropped.
1435      // A later REPLACE result still overrides this seed (the accumulator resets principal+roles on REPLACE).
1436      var existing = req.getUserPrincipal();
1437      if (existing != null)
1438         acc.add(AuthResult.of(existing));
1439      for (var a : auths)
1440         a.authenticate(req).ifPresent(acc::add);  // RestRequest is-a HttpServletRequest; AuthenticationException propagates -> 401
1441      acc.result().ifPresent(req::setAuthResult);
1442   }

1444   /**
1445    * The resolving {@link Config} for this resource.

1447    * <p>
1448    * Wraps the builder's unresolved config with a {@link VarResolver} session so that SVL variables
1449    * in config values are expanded on access.
1450    */
1451   private final Memoizer<Config> config = memoizer(() -> rawConfig.get().resolving(getVarResolver().createSession()));

1453   /**
1454    * The supported request content types ({@code Content-Type} media types) for this resource.
1455    *
1456    * <p>
1457    * Walks {@code @Rest(consumes)} annotations parent-to-child and returns the union. When no annotation
1458    * declares types, falls back to the intersection of all op-level parser supported media types.
1459    */
1460   private final Memoizer<List<MediaType>> consumes = memoizer(() -> {
1461      // Walk @Rest(consumes=...) chain (parent-to-child); concat all entries in chain order.
1462      var fromAnnotations = new ArrayList<MediaType>();
1463      getRestAnnotationsForProperty("consumes")
1464         .forEach(ai -> stream(ai.inner().consumes()).map(MediaType::of).forEach(fromAnnotations::add));
1465      if (! fromAnnotations.isEmpty())
1466         return u(fromAnnotations);
1467      // Fall back to the intersection of opContexts' parser-supported media types — matches legacy behavior.
1468      var opContexts = restOperations().getOpContexts();
1469      Set<MediaType> s = opContexts.isEmpty() ? emptySet() : toSet(opContexts.get(0).getParsers().getSupportedMediaTypes());
1470      opContexts.forEach(x -> s.retainAll(x.getParsers().getSupportedMediaTypes()));
1471      return u(toList(s));
1472   });

1492   /**
1493    * The env-driven {@code RestContext.*} default properties for this resource.
1494    *
1495    * <p>
1496    * Materialized through {@link BeanInstantiator}, which runs the {@code @ConfigProperties} resolution hook and
1497    * auto-registers the bound instance into {@link #beanStore()}. The bind resolves each {@code RestContext.*} key
1498    * against the resource's per-resource {@link PropertySource PropertySource}s
1499    * (including a {@code @Rest(config=...)} file) ahead of the global settings chain, so a config-file key takes
1500    * effect in the resolved defaults. This memoizer is forced exactly once during construction (after the
1501    * PropertySources are registered) so the single bound instance is the same one held in the bean store; see the
1502    * constructor for the ordering rationale.
1503    */
1504   private final Memoizer<RestContextProperties> restContextProperties = memoizer(() ->
1505      BeanInstantiator.of(RestContextProperties.class, beanStore()).run());

1507   /**
1508    * The default request attributes contributed by {@code @Rest(defaultRequestAttributes)} for this resource.
1509    *
1510    * <p>
1511    * Walks {@code @Rest} annotations parent-to-child, resolving each attribute string and parsing it as a
1512    * key=value or key:value pair. A named bean-store override or {@code @Bean} factory method REPLACES
1513    * the accumulated result.
1514    */
1515   private final Memoizer<NamedAttributeMap> defaultRequestAttributes = memoizer(() -> {

1644   /**
1645    * The {@link Messages} bundle for this resource.
1646    *
1647    * <p>
1648    * Walks {@code @Rest} annotations parent-to-child, resolving each {@code messages} location string
1649    * against the bootstrap resolver (full resolver not yet available — it depends on {@code getMessages()}).
1650    * A bean-store override or {@code @Bean} factory method REPLACES the result.
1651    */
1652   private final Memoizer<Messages> messages = memoizer(() -> {
1653      var b = Messages.create(resourceClass());
1654      // Walk @Rest annotations parent-to-child; child wins because location() prepends.
1655      // Resolve location strings against the simple resolver — full resolver isn't available yet
1656      // (it depends on getMessages()).
1657      // NOTE: messages is structurally bundle-CHAINED (not list/replace-merged), so it keeps its
1658      // own local location walk + Messages.chain rather than routing through getRestAnnotationsForProperty
1659      // (which would double-count host locations for a mixin context).  The two @Mixin hooks are layered on
1660      // explicitly instead: (1) a host @Mixin(messages=...) location is applied last (highest priority), and
1661      // (2) the host→mixin chain cutoff consults the unified noInherit set, so @Mixin(noInherit="messages")
1662      // cuts the host bundle exactly like the mixin class's own @Rest(noInherit="messages").
1663      var vrs = getBootstrapVarResolver().createSession();
1664      getRestAnnotationsTopDown().forEach(ai -> ai.getString("messages").filter(StringUtils::isNotBlank).ifPresent(s -> b.location(vrs.resolve(s))));
1665      var rmMessages = resolvedMixinField();
1666      if (rmMessages != null) {
1667         var mm = rmMessages.overrides().messages();
1668         if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(mm))
1669            b.location(vrs.resolve(mm));
1670      }
1671      var override = beanStore().createBeanFromMethod(Messages.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod, b).orElse(null);
1672      var local = nn(override) ? override : b.build();
1673      var parent = parentContext();
1674      // Use the SVL-free isNoInheritLiteral (NOT the noInherit memoizer) to avoid a resolver cycle:
1675      // noInherit -> resolveCdl -> getVarResolver -> getMessages -> messages.  It now also consults the
1676      // host @Mixin(noInherit=...) tokens so a @Mixin can cut the host bundle just like the mixin class's own.
1677      if (isMixinContextField() && nn(parent) && !isNoInheritLiteral("messages"))
1678         return Messages.chain(local, parent.getMessages());
1679      return local;
1680   });

1883   /**
1884    * JVM-wide cache of {@link ResponseProcessor} provider classes discovered via {@link ServiceLoader}.
1885    *

1888    * {@code juneau-rest-server} classpath; non-empty only when an opt-in module (e.g.
1889    * {@code juneau-rest-server-reactive}) ships a
1890    * {@code META-INF/services/ResponseProcessor} provider file.
1891    */
1892   @SuppressWarnings({
1893      "java:S3077" // volatile is required for correct double-checked-locking safe-publication of this JVM-wide cache; the reference is publish-once and never compound-mutated.
1894   })
1895   private static volatile List<Class<? extends ResponseProcessor>> serviceLoaderResponseProcessors;
1896
1897   /**
1898    * Returns the module-contributed {@link ResponseProcessor} classes discovered via {@link ServiceLoader},
1899    * caching the result for the lifetime of the JVM.
1900    *
1901    * <p>
1902    * Provider <em>types</em> are resolved (not instantiated) so each {@link RestContext} can instantiate its
1903    * own bean-store-injected copy. Discovery failures are swallowed at {@code FINE} so a malformed provider
1904    * never fails resource startup; on a bare classpath the returned list is empty and the default processor
1905    * chain is unchanged.
1906    *
1907    * @return The discovered processor classes (possibly empty, never {@code null}).
1908    */
1909   private static List<Class<? extends ResponseProcessor>> discoverServiceLoaderResponseProcessors() {
1910      var p = serviceLoaderResponseProcessors;
1911      if (p == null) {
1912         synchronized (RestContext.class) {
1913            p = serviceLoaderResponseProcessors;
1914            if (p == null) {
1915               p = loadServiceLoaderResponseProcessors();
1916               serviceLoaderResponseProcessors = p;
1917            }
1918         }
1919      }
1920      return p;
1921   }
1922
1923   private static List<Class<? extends ResponseProcessor>> loadServiceLoaderResponseProcessors() {
1924      var out = new ArrayList<Class<? extends ResponseProcessor>>();
1925      try {
1926         for (var it = ServiceLoader.load(ResponseProcessor.class).stream().iterator(); it.hasNext();)
1927            addNextServiceLoaderResponseProcessor(out, it);
1928      } catch (ServiceConfigurationError | RuntimeException e) {
1929         LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "ServiceLoader for ResponseProcessor failed: " + e.getMessage());
1930      }
1931      return List.copyOf(out);
1932   }
1933
1934   private static void addNextServiceLoaderResponseProcessor(List<Class<? extends ResponseProcessor>> out, Iterator<ServiceLoader.Provider<ResponseProcessor>> it) {
1935      try {
1936         out.add(it.next().type());
1937      } catch (ServiceConfigurationError | RuntimeException e) {
1938         LOG.log(Level.FINE, e, () -> "Skipping ServiceLoader-discovered ResponseProcessor: " + e.getMessage());
1939      }
1940   }

1942   /**
1943    * The ordered array of {@link ResponseProcessor} instances for this resource.
1944    *
1945    * <p>
1946    * Walks {@code @Rest(responseProcessors)} annotations parent-to-child (append order). A bean-store
1947    * override or {@code @Bean} factory method REPLACES the entire list.
1948    */
1949   private final Memoizer<ResponseProcessor[]> responseProcessors = memoizer(() -> {
1950      // Walk @Rest(responseProcessors=...) chain (parent-to-child via getRestAnnotationsForProperty).
1951      // DefaultConfig contributes the framework defaults at the top of the chain; resource-class entries append.
1952      // ResponseProcessorList.Builder.add(...) uses addAll (append) — final order: [DefaultConfig, parent, child].
1953      var bs = beanStore();
1954      var b = ResponseProcessorList.create(bs);
1955      // When enabled (default on-when-tracer), front-load the W3C trace-context processor so it
1956      // writes traceparent/tracestate headers before the body-rendering processors run. It short-circuits
1957      // at request time when no TracerHook stashed a trace context, so it's zero-cost on the no-tracer path.
1958      if (isResponseTraceparent())
1959         b.add(TraceContextResponseProcessor.class);
1960      // Front-load any module-contributed ResponseProcessors discovered via
1961      // ServiceLoader (e.g. the opt-in juneau-rest-server-reactive module's ReactiveResponseProcessor,
1962      // which must run ahead of AsyncResponseProcessor). Inert on a bare juneau-rest-server classpath —
1963      // when no module ships a META-INF/services/...ResponseProcessor provider file the list is empty and
1964      // the chain is identical to the pre-feature default.
1965      discoverServiceLoaderResponseProcessors().forEach(b::add);
1966      getRestAnnotationsForProperty("responseProcessors")
1967         .forEach(ai -> b.add(ai.inner().responseProcessors()));
1968      // @Bean method override REPLACES the entire annotation-derived list.
1969      var override = bs.createBeanFromMethod(ResponseProcessorList.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod, b).orElse(null);
1970      return (nn(override) ? override : b.build()).toArray();
1971   });

2128    * sub-contexts themselves never spawn further sub-contexts (the flat-inheritance rule: a mixin's
2129    * {@code @Rest(mixins=B)} discovers B as a mixin of the host, not as a nested mixin of A).
2130    *
2131    * <p>
2132    * Each sub-context is constructed with a {@link ContextKind.Mixin} {@link Args#kind() kind}, with its
2133    * {@code parentContext} pointing at this host context.  That parent-linkage drives the inheritance walk in
2134    * {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)} for serializers, parsers, encoders, converters, response
2135    * processors, REST op args, guards, restDebugFormatter, messages, varResolver tokens, etc.

2137    * @since 10.0.0
2138    */

2140      if (isMixinContextField())
2141         return Map.of();
2142      var out = new LinkedHashMap<Class<?>,RestContext>();
2143      for (var rm : getResolvedMixins()) {
2144         if (rm.type() == resourceClass())
2145            continue;
2146         RestContext mixinCtx;
2147         try {
2148            mixinCtx = buildMixinContext(rm);
2149         } catch (RuntimeException e) {
2150            throw e;
2151         } catch (Exception e) {
2152            throw rex(e, "Failed to construct mixin sub-context for %s: %s", rm.type().getName(), e.getMessage());
2153         }
2154         out.put(rm.type(), mixinCtx);
2155      }
2156      return u(out);
2157   });

2159   /**
2160    * Builds a per-mixin sub-{@link RestContext} for the given mixin class.
2161    *
2162    * <p>
2163    * Instantiates the mixin resource via this host's bean store, constructs a new {@link RestContext} with
2164    * {@code parentContext=this} and a {@link ContextKind.Mixin} {@link Args#kind() kind}, and reflectively invokes
2165    * any {@code setContext(RestContext)} method on the mixin instance (mirroring the existing
2166    * {@code RestChildren.buildChildContext(...)} contract).  The host's {@link ServletConfig} is propagated
2167    * so the mixin sees the same servlet container settings.
2168    *
2169    * <p>
2170    * Mixin instance resolution: an importer-supplied {@code @Bean <MixinClass>} factory in the host's
2171    * bean store wins over reflective instantiation. When the host registers
2172    * {@code @Bean public MyMixin myMixin() { ... }} (or a Spring {@code @Bean} of the same type), that
2173    * pre-built instance is used as the mixin resource; otherwise the mixin is instantiated via
2174    * {@code beanStore.instantiate(mixinClass)} (no-arg / builder / injected-constructor path). This lets
2175    * convention-endpoint mixins (favicon, SEO, version, well-known) be configured by the importer using
2176    * their own builder before the mixin walk wires them in.
2177    */
2178   private RestContext buildMixinContext(ResolvedMixin rm) throws Exception {
2179      var mixinClass = rm.type();
2180      Object preBuilt = beanStore.getBean(mixinClass).orElse(null);
2181      final var mixinResource = preBuilt != null ? preBuilt : beanStore.instantiate(mixinClass);
2182      var args = new Args(mixinClass, this, builder.inner, () -> mixinResource, "", null, null, null, new ContextKind.Mixin(rm));
2183      var mixinCtx = new RestContext(args);
2184      var setCtx = ClassInfo.of(mixinResource).getMethod(x -> x.hasName("setContext") && x.hasParameterTypes(RestContext.class)).orElse(null);
2185      if (setCtx != null)
2186         setCtx.accessible().invoke(mixinResource, mixinCtx);
2187      return mixinCtx;
2188   }

2201   /**
2202    * Returns the host-chosen mount prefix(es) declared on the {@code @Mixin} that produced this mixin
2203    * sub-context, for re-mounting the mixin's endpoints under host-chosen path(s).
2204    *
2205    * <p>
2206    * Resolved from {@link Mixin#path()} and {@link Mixin#paths()} (SVL-resolved, then normalized via the same
2207    * {@code pathToken} cleanup the bundled SVL-configurable mixins use — leading/trailing slashes and a trailing
2208    * {@code /*} wildcard stripped to a bare token).  {@link Mixin#path()} (single) and {@link Mixin#paths()}
2209    * (multi) are unioned; an empty result means "no host re-mount" (the mixin's own op paths apply unchanged).
2210    *
2211    * @return The normalized, de-duplicated mount-prefix tokens (no slashes), or an empty list when none; never {@code null}.
2212    * @since 10.0.0
2213    */
2214   public List<String> getMixinMountPrefixes() { return mixinMountPrefixes.get(); }

2216   /**
2217    * Memoized normalized {@code @Mixin(path/paths)} mount prefixes (built once; zero per-request cost).
2218    */
2219   private final Memoizer<List<String>> mixinMountPrefixes = memoizer(() -> {
2220      var rm = resolvedMixinField();
2221      if (rm == null || rm.hasNoOverrides())
2222         return List.of();
2223      var m = rm.overrides();
2224      var out = new LinkedHashSet<String>();
2225      var vrs = getBootstrapVarResolver().createSession();
2226      if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(m.path()))
2227         addMountPrefix(out, vrs.resolve(m.path()));
2228      for (var p : m.paths())
2229         if (StringUtils.isNotBlank(p))
2230            addMountPrefix(out, vrs.resolve(p));
2231      return List.copyOf(out);
2232   });
2233
2234   /** Normalizes one path override to a bare token (strip leading/trailing slashes and a trailing {@code /*}). */
2235   private static void addMountPrefix(Set<String> out, String raw) {
2236      var s = trim(raw);
2237      if (s.endsWith("/*"))
2238         s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 2);
2239      // Strip leading and trailing slashes.
2240      while (s.startsWith("/"))
2241         s = s.substring(1);
2242      while (s.endsWith("/"))
2243         s = s.substring(0, s.length() - 1);
2244      if (! s.isEmpty())
2245         out.add(s);
2246   }

2248   /**
2249    * The {@link RestOperations} for this resource — all {@link RestOpContext} instances built from
2250    * methods annotated with {@link RestOp @RestOp} (and related).
2251    *
2252    * <p>
2253    * Eagerly initialized in the constructor (via an explicit {@code .get()} call inside the try-catch block)
2254    * so that any {@link ServletException} surfaces at construction time rather than lazily on first request.
2255    * Subsequent calls return the cached instance.
2256    *
2257    * <p>
2258    * For mixin classes declared via {@link Rest#mixins() @Rest(mixins)}, each mixin's {@code @RestOp} methods
2259    * are bound to a per-mixin {@link RestContext} sub-context (see {@link #mixinContexts}) so that the
2260    * mixin's annotation chain inherits from the host's via {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)}.
2261    * Mixin sub-contexts themselves never participate in mixin discovery &mdash; the {@code if (!isMixinContext)}
2262    * guard below short-circuits the flat-inheritance rule (a mixin's {@code @Rest(mixins=B)} is collected at
2263    * the host level, not nested under A).
2264    */
2265   private final Memoizer<RestOperations> restOperations = memoizer(() -> safe(() -> {
2266      initializeFrameworkBeansForRestOps();
2267      var bs = beanStore();
2268      var b = RestOperations.create(bs);
2269      var ap = getMarshallingContext().getAnnotationProvider();
2270      var rci = ClassInfo.of(resource().get());
2271      if (!isMixinContextField()) {
2272         var contexts = mixinContexts.get();
2273         for (var e : contexts.entrySet()) {
2274            var mixinClass = e.getKey();
2275            var mixinCtx = e.getValue();
2276            addRestOperationsForClass(b, ap, ClassInfo.of(mixinClass), mixinCtx, mixinCtx::getResource);
2277         }
2278      }
2279      addRestOperationsForClass(b, ap, rci, this, this::getResource);
2280      var override = bs.createBeanFromMethod(RestOperations.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod, b).orElse(null);
2281      return nn(override) ? override : b.build();
2282   }));
2283
2284   private void addRestOperationsForClass(RestOperations.Builder b, AnnotationProvider ap, ClassInfo classInfo, RestContext opContext, Supplier<Object> targetSupplier) throws ServletException {
2285      for (var mi : classInfo.getPublicMethods()) {
2286         var al = rstream(ap.find(mi)).filter(REST_OP_GROUP).collect(Collectors.toList());
2287         if (al.isEmpty()) {
2288            Predicate<MethodInfo> isRestAnnotatedInterface = x -> x.getDeclaringClass().isInterface()
2289               && nn(x.getDeclaringClass().getAnnotations(Rest.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null));
2290            mi.getMatchingMethods().stream().filter(isRestAnnotatedInterface).forEach(x -> al.add(AnnotationInfo.of(x, RestOpAnnotation.DEFAULT)));
2291         }
2292         if (!al.isEmpty()) {
2293            try {
2294               if (mi.isNotPublic())
2295                  throw servletException("@RestOp method %s.%s must be defined as public.", classInfo.inner().getName(), mi.getNameSimple());
2296               var roc = new RestOpContext(mi.inner(), opContext, targetSupplier);
2297               if (eq(roc.getHttpMethod(), "RRPC")) {
2298                  RestOpContext roc2 = new RrpcRestOpContext(mi.inner(), opContext, targetSupplier);
2299                  b.add("GET", roc2).add("POST", roc2);
2300               } else {
2301                  b.add(roc);
2302               }
2303            } catch (Exception e) {
2304               throw servletException(e, "Problem occurred trying to initialize methods on class %s", classInfo.inner().getName());
2305            }
2306         }
2307      }
2308   }
