2310   /**
2311    * Discovers all mixins declared on this resource's {@code @Rest} chain, normalized to {@link ResolvedMixin}.
2312    *
2313    * <p>
2314    * Reads both {@link Rest#mixins() bare-class} and {@link Rest#mixinDefs() rich &#64;Mixin} entries (bare first,
2315    * then {@code mixinDefs}), recursing into each mixin class's own {@code @Rest(mixins=)}/{@code @Rest(mixinDefs=)}
2316    * (the flat-inheritance rule still applies — nested mixins are collected at the host level).  First occurrence
2317    * of a class wins for ordering; a rich {@code @Mixin} <b>upgrades</b> an earlier bare entry for the same class
2318    * (a bare class is just {@code @Mixin(type=X)} with empty overrides, so upgrading only adds the host overrides).
2319    *
2320    * @return The ordered, de-duplicated normalized mixins, never {@code null}.
2321    */
2322   private Collection<ResolvedMixin> getResolvedMixins() {
2323      var out = new LinkedHashMap<Class<?>,ResolvedMixin>();
2324      getRestAnnotationsForProperty("mixins").forEach(ai -> {
2325         for (var mixin : ai.inner().mixins())
2326            collectResolvedMixin(ResolvedMixin.ofBare(mixin), out);
2327         for (var def : ai.inner().mixinDefs())
2328            collectResolvedMixin(ResolvedMixin.ofDef(def), out);
2329      });
2330      return out.values();
2331   }
2332
2333   private void collectResolvedMixin(ResolvedMixin rm, LinkedHashMap<Class<?>,ResolvedMixin> out) {
2334      var type = rm.type();
2335      // type==null is defensive only — @Mixin.type() defaults to Object.class and a declarative @Mixin requires
2336      // a class literal, so it is never null in practice.  type==resourceClass() guards a host/mixin listing
2337      // itself (skip to avoid self-recursion).
2338      if (type == null || type == resourceClass())  // HTT: the null arm is not reachable via the annotation API.
2339         return;
2340      var existing = out.get(type);
2341      if (existing != null) {
2342         // Already discovered.  A rich @Mixin upgrades a bare entry (in place, preserving position); otherwise
2343         // the first occurrence wins and we do not recurse again.
2344         if (existing.hasNoOverrides() && ! rm.hasNoOverrides())
2345            out.put(type, rm);
2346         return;
2347      }
2348      out.put(type, rm);
2349      var r = type.getAnnotation(Rest.class);
2350      if (r != null) {
2351         for (var nested : r.mixins())
2352            collectResolvedMixin(ResolvedMixin.ofBare(nested), out);
2353         for (var nestedDef : r.mixinDefs())
2354            collectResolvedMixin(ResolvedMixin.ofDef(nestedDef), out);
2355      }
2356   }
2357
2358   /**
2359    * Discovers all children declared on this resource's {@code @Rest} chain, normalized to {@link ResolvedChild}.
2360    *
2361    * <p>
2362    * Reads both {@link Rest#children() bare-class} and {@link Rest#childrenDefs() rich &#64;Child} entries (bare
2363    * first, then {@code childrenDefs}). First occurrence of a class wins for ordering; a rich {@code @Child}
2364    * <b>upgrades</b> an earlier bare entry for the same class (a bare class is just {@code @Child(type=X)} with
2365    * an empty seed, so upgrading only adds the host-declared seed).
2366    *
2367    * <p>
2368    * Deliberately <b>non-recursive</b>, unlike {@link #getResolvedMixins()}: children do not flatten transitively
2369    * to the host — each child resolves its own nested {@code @Rest(children=...)}/{@code childrenDefs} independently
2370    * when its own {@link RestContext} is constructed.
2371    *
2372    * @return The ordered, de-duplicated normalized children, never {@code null}.
2373    */
2374   private Collection<ResolvedChild> getResolvedChildren() {
2375      var out = new LinkedHashMap<Class<?>,ResolvedChild>();
2376      getRestAnnotations().forEach(ai -> {
2377         for (var c : ai.inner().children())
2378            collectResolvedChild(ResolvedChild.ofBare(c), out);
2379         for (var def : ai.inner().childrenDefs())
2380            collectResolvedChild(ResolvedChild.ofDef(def), out);
2381      });
2382      return out.values();
2383   }
2384
2385   private void collectResolvedChild(ResolvedChild rc, LinkedHashMap<Class<?>,ResolvedChild> out) {
2386      var type = rc.type();
2387      // type==null is defensive only — @Child.type() is required and a declarative @Child requires a class
2388      // literal, so it is never null in practice.  type==resourceClass() guards a self-reference (skip to
2389      // avoid an infinite loop).
2390      if (type == null || type == resourceClass())  // HTT: the null arm is not reachable via the annotation API.
2391         return;
2392      var existing = out.get(type);
2393      if (existing != null) {
2394         // Already discovered.  A rich @Child upgrades a bare entry (in place, preserving position); otherwise
2395         // the first occurrence wins.  No recursion into the child's own nested children (see javadoc above).
2396         if (existing.hasNoSeed() && ! rc.hasNoSeed())
2397            out.put(type, rc);
2398         return;
2399      }
2400      out.put(type, rc);  // No recursion into type's own children — each child owns its own subtree.
2401   }

2403   /**
2404    * The {@link RestChildren} for this resource — child {@link RestContext} instances registered via
2405    * {@link Rest#children() @Rest(children)}/{@link Rest#childrenDefs() childrenDefs}.
2406    *
2407    * <p>
2408    * Reads children (bare and rich) directly from the {@code @Rest} annotation chain via
2409    * {@link #getResolvedChildren()}, instantiates each child via the bean store, and builds a {@link RestContext}
2410    * for each, threading through any host-declared {@code @Child} seed. Eagerly initialized in the constructor
2411    * (via an explicit {@code .get()} call inside the try-catch block) so that any construction failure surfaces
2412    * at initialization time rather than lazily.
2413    */
2414   private final Memoizer<RestChildren> restChildren = memoizer(() -> safe(() -> {
2415      var bs = beanStore();
2416      var servletConfig = bs.getBean(ServletConfig.class).orElse(null);
2417      var b = RestChildren.create(this, bs, servletConfig);
2418
2419      var lazy = isLazyChildren();
2420
2421      for (var rc2 : getResolvedChildren()) {
2422         if (lazy) {
2423            // Lazy: register a routing stub now; defer full RestContext construction to first request.
2424            // The stub carries the full ResolvedChild (including any host-declared @Child seed), so a
2425            // lazily-materialized child receives its seed on first invocation identically to an eager one.
2426            b.addLazy(rc2, "");
2427         } else {
2428            // Eager (default): build the full child RestContext immediately, seed included.
2429            b.add(RestChildren.buildChildContext(this, bs, servletConfig, rc2, null, ""));
2430         }
2431      }
2432
2433      // @Bean override — allows replacing the entire RestChildren instance.
2434      var override = bs.createBeanFromMethod(RestChildren.class, resource().get(), RestContext::isBeanMethod, b).orElse(null);
2435      return nn(override) ? override : b.build();
2436   }));

2438   /**
2439    * Constructor.
2440    *
2441    * @param args The bootstrap arguments. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
2442    * @throws Exception If any initialization problems were encountered.
2443    * @since 10.0.0
2444    */
2445   public RestContext(Args args) throws Exception {
2446      this(new Builder(args));
2447   }
2448
2449   /**
2450    * Internal constructor.
2451    *
2452    * <p>
2453    * Privatized in the April 2026 refactor (2026-04-19). External callers must use
2454    * {@link #RestContext(Args)} instead.
2455    *
2456    * @param builder The builder containing the settings for this bean.
2457    * @throws Exception If any initialization problems were encountered.
2458    */
2459   private RestContext(Builder builder) throws Exception {
2460      super(builder);
2461
2462      startTime = Instant.now();
2463
2464      REGISTRY.put(builder.resourceClass, this);
2465
2466      BasicHttpException initExceptionTemp = null;
2467
2468      try {
2469         this.builder = builder;
2470
2471         parentContext = builder.parentContext;
2472         contextKind = builder.args.kind();
2473         isMixinContext = contextKind instanceof ContextKind.Mixin;
2474         resolvedMixin = (contextKind instanceof ContextKind.Mixin contextKind2) ? contextKind2.def() : null;
2475         resolvedChild = (contextKind instanceof ContextKind.Child contextKind3) ? contextKind3.def() : null;
2476         resourceClass = builder.resourceClass;
2477         var rs = new ResourceSupplier(resourceClass, reqnn("resource", builder.args.resource()));
2478         resource = rs;
2479
2480         // Resolve the programmatic configuration builder.  Prefer the one carried on Args (set by
2481         // RestServlet.init()); otherwise read the builder stashed on the resource instance (non-reflective) so
2482         // programmatic construction via MockRestClient, child mounting, and mixin composition all honor it.
2483         var rb = builder.args.restBuilder();
2484         if (rb == null)
2485            rb = stashedRestBuilder(rs.get());
2486         restBuilder = rb;
2487         if (restBuilder instanceof AbstractRestBuilder<?,?> restBuilder2) {
2488            // Synthetic, highest-priority @Rest carrying the builder-set members; prepended (most-derived
2489            // child position) to the @Rest chain by the restAnnotations memoizer so builder values win.
2490            builderRestAnnotation = restBuilder2.toRestAnnotation();
2491            // Programmatic mdcAsyncPropagation knob (no @Rest member) wins over the env-driven default.
2492            if (restBuilder2.getMdcAsyncPropagation() != null && builder.mdcAsyncPropagation == null)
2493               builder.mdcAsyncPropagation = restBuilder2.getMdcAsyncPropagation();
2494         } else {
2495            builderRestAnnotation = null;
2496         }
2497
2498         // --- beanStore setup (May 2026 refactor; precedence-flipped 10.0) ---
2499
2500         // Determine the parent (bootstrap) store: inherited from parent resource if present.
2501         //
2502         // For mixin sub-contexts, the parent is the host's FULL beanStore (not just the bootstrap layer)
2503         // so that resource-class-level @Bean factory methods declared on the host class are visible to
2504         // the mixin's resolution chain.  Mixin endpoints resolved through the host's beanStore directly;
2505         // with per-mixin sub-contexts, the same effect is
2506         // achieved by parent-linking the mixin's beanStore to the host's full beanStore.
2507         //
2508         // For @Rest(children) sub-resources, the parent is the host's inheritable layer: the host's bootstrap
2509         // store plus the host's own non-framework @Bean method results and @Bean field values.  Children see
2510         // the group's beans (transitively, since each child's inheritable layer sits on top of its parent's),
2511         // but not the host's framework-managed beans (serializers, call logger, children, ...), which stay
2512         // per-context.
2513         WritableBeanStore parentBs;
2514         if (parentContext != null && isMixinContext)
2515            parentBs = parentContext.beanStore;
2516         else if (parentContext != null)
2517            parentBs = parentContext.inheritableBeanStore;
2518         else
2519            parentBs = null;
2520
2521         // Build the initial beanStore; honor an optional @Bean WritableBeanStore override.
2522         // In the new 10.0 precedence model, the parent (Spring or parent-resource bootstrap) is
2523         // installed as the overriding parent so it wins over local entries.
2524         // Args.overridingParent threads into the per-resource (final beanStore) overridingParent
2525         // slot so test-time overlays (TestBeanStore) resolve at tier 1 of the chain ahead of
2526         // any @Bean factory result registered as a local entry below.
2527         // @formatter:off
2528         var argsOverlay = builder.args.overridingParent();
2529         WritableBeanStore bs = createBeanStore(parentBs, rs, parentBs == null ? null : argsOverlay)
2530            .addBean(ResourceSupplier.class, rs)
2531            .addBean(ServletConfig.class, nn(builder.inner) ? builder.inner : builder)
2532            .addBean(ServletContext.class, (nn(builder.inner) ? builder.inner : builder).getServletContext());
2533         // @formatter:on
2534
2535         // If no parent store, promote bs to bootstrap and layer a fresh per-resource v2 store on top.
2536         // The overlay belongs on the per-resource store so it wins over @Bean factories registered
2537         // as local entries below; the bootstrap deliberately does NOT get the overlay (it sits above
2538         // the per-resource entries via the parent chain, which is too low for an overlay).
2539         if (parentBs == null) {
2540            bootstrapBeanStore = bs;
2541            bs = new BasicBeanStore(bootstrapBeanStore, argsOverlay);
2542         } else {
2543            bootstrapBeanStore = parentBs;
2544         }
2545         beanStore = bs;
2546         inheritableBeanStore = new BasicBeanStore(bootstrapBeanStore);
2547
2548         beanStore.addBean(WritableBeanStore.class, beanStore);
2549         // Register the bootstrap VarResolver as a NAMED entry only.  The unnamed VarResolver
2550         // slot is intentionally left to the registerFrameworkDefaults() default supplier (which
2551         // resolves to the full runtime VarResolver) so that internal accessors such as
2552         // getVarResolver() return the right thing when routed through beanStore.getBean(...).
2553         beanStore.add(VarResolver.class, getBootstrapVarResolver(), "bootstrapVarResolver");
2554         // Force-build raw Config now (fail fast if @Rest(config) is misconfigured).  The unnamed
2555         // Config slot in the bean store is intentionally left to the default supplier (the full
2556         // runtime Config) — @RestInit hooks that take Config as a parameter will see the fully
2557         // resolved instance instead of the raw bootstrap Config (10.0 behavior change).
2558         rawConfig.get();
2559         // Per-RestContext @Value resolution bridge: register the @Rest(config=...) Configs as
2560         // PropertySource beans inside THIS resource's BeanStore (NOT on the process-wide
2561         // Settings.get() singleton — that path was a 6.7x perf regression because
2562         // MockRestClient's static RestContext cache leaks instances and Settings.get()'s source
2563         // list grew unbounded). Per-resource isolation comes for free from the BeanStore scope.
2564         registerRestConfigPropertySources();
2565
2566         // Materialize the RestContextProperties bean exactly once, now that the per-resource PropertySources are
2567         // registered.  Forcing it here (rather than on first lazy .get()) is required for correctness:
2568         //   1. Single instance / store identity — the materialization side effect (BeanInstantiator auto-registers
2569         //      the bound bean into beanStore() via addDefaultSupplier) must run exactly once.  A lazy first-.get()
2570         //      under concurrent access could run the memoizer supplier more than once (the memoizer is CAS-based and
2571         //      does not cache the winner before running the supplier), registering two instances last-writer-wins and
2572         //      breaking getRestContextProperties() == beanStore().getBean(RestContextProperties.class).
2573         //   2. Mixin sub-context isolation — the auto-registration lands as a tier-4 default supplier on THIS store.
2574         //      Forcing it before promoteDefaultsToLocalSuppliers() (below) lets a mixin sub-context promote its own
2575         //      registration to a local (tier-2) entry, so the mixin's beanStore().getBean(RestContextProperties.class)
2576         //      resolves ITS OWN bean instead of walking up to the parent-linked host's tier-4 default.
2577         // Materialization must complete here so the bound bean is present and promotable before the @Bean /
2578         // @RestInit walk (and the promoteDefaultsToLocalSuppliers() step below) run against this store.
2579         getRestContextProperties();
2580
2581         // Register memoizer-backed defaults for every framework-managed type.  These sit at the
2582         // bottom of the precedence order and only fire when no @Bean method, no programmatic
2583         // add, and no Spring/overriding-parent bean has been registered for the type.  This is
2584         // what removes the need for the old DELAYED_INJECTION gate-keeping list — the @Bean
2585         // walk below can now invoke any framework type's factory and still resolve framework
2586         // dependencies through the bean store.
2587         registerFrameworkDefaults(beanStore);
2588
2589         var rci2 = ClassInfo.of(resourceClass);
2590
2591         // Build the annotation work list as early as possible in construction — immediately after
2592         // registerFrameworkDefaults() registers the framework-bean default suppliers above, and
2593         // before any step below (the @Bean field/method scan, @RestInit hooks, or the @Bean field
2594         // back-fill) that can trigger a beanStore lookup and force-evaluate a creator/builder memoizer
2595         // that reads annotationWork directly (partSerializerCreator, partParserCreator,
2596         // jsonSchemaGeneratorBuilder, beanContextBuilder). Building it this late used to leave those
2597         // memoizers exposed to an NPE whenever something forced them early — e.g. a @Bean static
2598         // witness field of type HttpPartSerializer, or an @RestInit method parameter of one of the
2599         // affected framework types — since annotationWork was still null at that point.
2600         var vrs = getBootstrapVarResolver().createSession();
2601         annotationWork = AnnotationWorkList.of(vrs, rstream(AnnotationProvider.INSTANCE.find(rci2)).filter(CONTEXT_APPLY_FILTER));
2602
2603         // For mixin sub-contexts, the bean store is parent-linked to the host's full beanStore so that
2604         // host-declared @Bean factory results (e.g. @Bean(name="db") HealthIndicator dbIndicator()) are
2605         // visible through the mixin's lookup chain.  But the parent walk also picks up the host's
2606         // framework defaults (SerializerSet, ParserSet, RichLogger, ...) at the parent's tier-4 slot
2607         // before this store's tier-4 defaults can fire — which would shadow this mixin's per-context
2608         // framework objects.  Promoting our defaults into local entries (tier 2) makes them resolve
2609         // ahead of the parent walk while still letting an overriding parent (e.g. Spring) and explicit
2610         // local @Bean registrations win.  Top-level resources and @Rest(children=...) sub-resources keep
2611         // the original tier-4 default semantics so a parent-supplied framework bean (e.g. Spring's
2612         // SerializerSet) still wins as it did before.
2613         if (isMixinContext && beanStore instanceof BasicBeanStore beanStore2)
2614            beanStore2.promoteDefaultsToLocalSuppliers();
2615         else if (parentContext != null && parentContext.isMixinContext)
2616            // A child-of-mixin sub-context's bean store is parent-linked to its parent (the mixin), but the
2617            // mixin's OWN bootstrap layer is the host's full beanStore (see parentBs selection above), so the
2618            // chain reaches the host's full store, whose tier-4 RestContextProperties default would otherwise
2619            // resolve ahead of this child's own tier-4 default (children run no promotion). Pin this child's
2620            // own bound instance as a local (tier-2) entry so that beanStore().getBean(RestContextProperties.class)
2621            // matches getRestContextProperties(). This narrows the promotion to this single type and to the
2622            // child-of-mixin case specifically, leaving ordinary (non-mixin-parented) children at normal
2623            // tier-4 default / parent-wins semantics, so a Spring/parent-supplied bean still wins for them.
2624            beanStore.addBean(RestContextProperties.class, getRestContextProperties());
2625
2626         // Register @Bean fields that already have a value.  Non-framework values are also exported to the
2627         // inheritable layer so that @Rest(children) sub-resources see them.  Each registered (type, name) key is
2628         // recorded so that a @Bean method with the same key does not overwrite the field (first wins).
2629         // Framework-typed fields (including named ones such as @Bean(name="encoders") EncoderSet) keep their
2630         // raw value locally and are not exported; unlike framework-typed methods they are not aliased.
2631         var registeredKeys = new HashSet<List<Object>>();
2632         // @formatter:off
2633         rci2.getAllFields().stream()
2634            .filter(x -> x.hasAnnotation(Bean.class))
2635            .forEach(x -> o(x.get(resource.get())).ifPresent(y -> {
2636               var ft = x.getFieldType().<Object>inner();
2637               var name = BeanAnnotation.name(x.getAnnotations(Bean.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null));
2638               beanStore.add(ft, y, name);
2639               registeredKeys.add(List.of(ft, name));
2640               if (isInheritableBeanType(ft, name))
2641                  inheritableBeanStore.add(ft, y, name);
2642            }));
2643         // @formatter:on
2644
2645         // Run @Bean methods and register their results as LOCAL entries (level 2 of resolve()).
2646         //
2647         // Each @Bean method is invoked directly (BeanStore.invokeBeanMethod) and its own result is registered under
2648         // its own (return type, name) key, so several same-typed methods with different names yield distinct beans.
2649         // Methods of any visibility (public, protected, package-private, private) and static methods are honored.
2650         // NOTE: for a proxied (e.g. CGLIB) resource, non-public methods run against the resource object as-is.
2651         //
2652         // Walk order is child class first, then superclasses, with interface default methods after all superclasses.
2653         // The first method to claim a (type, name) key wins; an unresolvable method (missing parameters)
2654         // claims nothing, so a later candidate can still fill the key.  An overridden method runs once (the
2655         // override); if the parent declares a covariant (wider) return type, the override's instance is also
2656         // registered under the parent's type.  Methods with a non-empty methodScope() are op-scoped and skipped
2657         // here (RestOpContext handles them); interface static methods are ignored.
2658         //
2659         // For framework types (those with a default supplier registered above, under the exact name or unnamed):
2660         // the @Bean scan already ran inside the corresponding memoizer body (see e.g. the `logger` memoizer above),
2661         // so invoking the method here would create a SECOND instance and produce inconsistent state between the
2662         // framework's memoizer-backed bean and the bean store's local entry.  Instead, the existing default
2663         // supplier (memoizer-backed, resolving to the @Bean value when one was supplied) is PROMOTED into a
2664         // local-entry supplier.  A framework type has one per-context instance, so when the method is named but only
2665         // an unnamed default exists (e.g. @Bean(name="encoders") EncoderSet), the name becomes an alias of that
2666         // single instance.  Framework types are never exported to children (framework-type isolation).
2667         // Promoting at level 2 means @Bean results win over a parent (Spring) at level 3.
2668         //
2669         // Net effect: @Bean method results uniformly take precedence over Spring/parent
2670         // bindings for both framework and user-defined types.  This auto-derives the legacy
2671         // DELAYED_INJECTION list from the default-supplier registrations.
2672         var walkedMethods = new HashMap<String,Object[]>();              // Signature -> {returnType, instance|null} for overridable methods.
2673         var frameworkMethods = new LinkedHashMap<Class<?>,List<String>>();  // Framework type -> method names (for the duplicate warning).
2674         rci2.getAllMethods().forEach(x -> {
2675            if (x.isStatic() && x.inner().getDeclaringClass().isInterface())
2676               return;
2677            var found = BeanAnnotation.find(x).orElse(null);
2678            if (found == null || found.methodScope().length > 0)
2679               return;
2680            var rt = x.getReturnType().<Object>inner();
2681            var name = BeanAnnotation.name(found);
2682            // Skip the WritableBeanStore factory (already consumed by createBeanStore()) and void methods.
2683            if (WritableBeanStore.class.equals(rt) || BeanStore.class.equals(rt) || void.class.equals(rt))
2684               return;
2685            var overridable = ! x.isPrivate() && ! x.isStatic();
2686            var sig = x.getSignature();
2687            if (overridable) {
2688               var previous = walkedMethods.get(sig);
2689               if (previous != null || walkedMethods.containsKey(sig)) {
2690                  // Overridden parent copy: never invoked.  Covariant override: share the child's instance under the parent's type.
2691                  // The parent's (type, name) key obeys first-wins too, so an earlier @Bean field or method keeps it.
2692                  if (previous != null && previous[0] != rt && previous[1] != null && registeredKeys.add(List.of(rt, name))) {
2693                     beanStore.addBean(rt, previous[1], name);
2694                     if (isInheritableBeanType(rt, name))
2695                        inheritableBeanStore.addBean(rt, previous[1], name);
2696                  }
2697                  return;
2698               }
2699               walkedMethods.put(sig, null);
2700            }
2701            if (isFrameworkBeanType(rt, name)) {
2702               frameworkMethods.computeIfAbsent(rt, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(x.getName());
2703               if (beanStore instanceof BasicBeanStore beanStore2) {
2704                  if (beanStore2.hasDefaultSupplier(rt, name))
2705                     beanStore2.getDefaultSupplier(rt, name).ifPresent(sup -> beanStore.addSupplier(rt, sup, name));
2706                  else
2707                     beanStore2.getDefaultSupplier(rt, "").ifPresent(sup -> beanStore.addSupplier(rt, sup, name));
2708               }
2709               return;
2710            }
2711            if (registeredKeys.contains(List.of(rt, name)))
2712               return;
2713            beanStore.invokeBeanMethod(rt, x, resource.get()).ifPresent(y -> {
2714               registeredKeys.add(List.of(rt, name));
2715               if (overridable)
2716                  walkedMethods.put(sig, new Object[]{rt, y});
2717               beanStore.addBean(rt, y, name);
2718               // Same instance, exported so @Rest(children) sub-resources see it.
2719               inheritableBeanStore.addBean(rt, y, name);
2720            });
2721         });
2722         frameworkMethods.forEach((type, methods) -> {
2723            if (methods.size() > 1)
2724               LOG.warning("Resource class %s declares multiple @Bean methods %s of framework type %s.  A framework type has one per-context instance, so all of these names alias it.", resourceClass().getName(), methods, type.getName());
2725         });
2726
2727         // Run @RestInit-annotated methods on the resource object (deduplicated by signature, top-down order).
2728         // Note: pre-10.0 this filter also excluded `y.hasParameter(RestOpContext.Builder.class)` because the
2729         // per-op `@RestInit(RestOpContext.Builder)` flow handled those separately. That flow was deleted in
2730         // April 2026 refactor Route B (zero real-world callers), so the exclusion is gone too. Likewise, the
2731         // class-level `@RestInit(RestContext.Builder)` injection protocol was deleted in the same refactor
2732         // (zero non-test callers anywhere) — `RestContext.Builder` is no longer added to the bean store, so
2733         // any straggling `@RestInit` method that still declares either Builder type as a parameter will now
2734         // surface a "missing prerequisites" error here, which is the desired loud-failure signal.
2735         var r = resource.get();
2736         var initMap = CollectionUtils.<String,MethodInfo>map();
2737         ClassInfo.ofProxy(r).getAllMethodsTopDown().stream()
2738            .filter(y -> y.hasAnnotation(RestInit.class))
2739            .forEach(y -> { var sig = y.getSignature(); if (!initMap.containsKey(sig)) initMap.put(sig, y.accessible()); });
2740         for (var m : initMap.values()) {
2741            if (!m.canResolveAllParameters(beanStore, r))
2742               throw servletException("Could not call @RestInit method %s.%s.  Could not find prerequisites: %s.", cns(m.getDeclaringClass()), m.getSignature(), m.getMissingParameterTypes(beanStore, r));
2743            try {
2744               m.inject(beanStore, r);
2745            } catch (Exception e) {
2746               throw servletException(e, "Exception thrown from @RestInit method %s.%s.", cns(m.getDeclaringClass()), m.getSignature());
2747            }
2748         }
2749
2750         // Back-fill @Bean fields that were null before init hooks ran.
2751         // @formatter:off
2752         rci2.getAllFields().stream()
2753            .filter(x -> x.hasAnnotation(Bean.class))
2754            .forEach(x -> x.setIfNull(
2755               resource.get(),
2756               beanStore.getBean(
2757                  x.getFieldType().inner(),
2758                  BeanAnnotation.name(x.getAnnotations(Bean.class).findFirst().map(AnnotationInfo::inner).orElse(null))
2759               ).orElse(null)
2760            ));
2761         // @formatter:on
2762
2763         // Populate @Inject-annotated fields and methods on the resource, then fire @PostConstruct
2764         // callbacks.  This covers the JSR-330 / Spring @Autowired / jakarta.inject.Inject FQNs as
2765         // well as the Juneau-owned @Inject in commons.inject — recognition is FQN-based, see JsrSupport.
2766         rci2.inject(resource.get(), beanStore);
2767
2768         builder.args.beanStoreConfigurer().accept(beanStore);
2769
2770         // --- end beanStore setup ---
2771
2772         // Path resolution: explicit Args.path (non-empty) wins so callers like
2773         // RestChildren.addChild(String,Object) can mount the same class at a custom path; otherwise read
2774         // from the @Rest(path) annotation chain (most-derived class wins). This restores override behavior
2775         // removed in the May 2026 Builder.path elimination, without resurrecting the staging field.
2776         var argsPath = builder.args.path();
2777         if (argsPath != null && ! argsPath.isEmpty()) {
2778            path = trimLeadingSlashes(argsPath);
2779         } else {
2780            path = getRestAnnotations().stream()
2781               .map(ai -> ai.inner().path())
2782               .filter(StringUtils::isNotEmpty)
2783               .findFirst()
2784               .map(s -> trimLeadingSlashes(s))
2785               .orElse("");
2786         }
2787         fullPath = (parentContext == null ? "" : (parentContext.fullPath + '/')) + path;
2788         var p = path;
2789         if (! p.endsWith("/*"))
2790            p += "/*";
2791         pathMatcher = UrlPathMatcher.of(p);
2792
2793         // Top-level mount-paths resolution chain (programmatic > getter > annotation default).
2794         // See javadoc on getPaths() for the full precedence order. Resolution happens once at construction;
2795         // the resolved array is what hosting runtimes (Jetty auto-discovery, Spring Boot ServletRegistrationBean)
2796         // should consume rather than reading the raw @Rest(paths) annotation directly.  Each @Rest(paths)
2797         // element is SVL-resolved through a VarResolver session backed by the live bean store — so
2798         // ${C:key} consults whatever Config is currently registered (test overlay, @Bean factory, or the
2799         // framework's runtime Config) and ${E:NAME:default} / ${S:prop:default} use the bootstrap variable
2800         // catalog without needing any beans.  The session-with-beanstore form is what makes test-time
2801         // Config injection visible to SVL without firing the full runtime VarResolver memoizer.
2802         paths = resolveMountPaths(builder, resource.get(), getBootstrapVarResolver(), beanStore, getRestAnnotations());
2803
2804         // annotationWork was already built above (right after registerFrameworkDefaults(), well before
2805         // any step that could force-evaluate a memoizer reading it) — force-init beanContextBuilder
2806         // here so annotation work is applied before the builder is used by any other memoizer.
2807         beanContextBuilder.get();
2808
2809         // @formatter:off
2810         beanStore
2811            .addBean(RestContext.class, this)
2812            .addBean(Object.class, resource.get())
2813            .addBean(Builder.class, builder)
2814            .addBean(AnnotationWorkList.class, annotationWork);
2815         // @formatter:on
2816
2817      // Inject the remaining @Value-annotated env-driven defaults (debug level, uriAuthority, uriContext) onto
2818      // this RestContext instance so that the memoizer lambdas below (which run lazily on first .get() call)
2819      // read fully resolved values.
2820      ClassInfo.of(this).inject(this, beanStore);
2821
2822      // Startup-fail if @Rest(observability="true") is set but neither MetricsRecorder nor TracerHook is
2823      // supplied. The check runs after all @Bean method injection so that consumer-provided beans are visible.
2824      checkObservabilityBackendPresent();
2825
2826      // Startup-fail: if asyncCompletionExecutor is configured (either by annotation or
2827      // programmatically), force-evaluate the memoizer now so "bean not found" surfaces at context
2828      // init time rather than lazily on the first request.
2829      checkAsyncCompletionExecutorPresent();
2830
2831      if (isEagerInit()) {
2832            // Force-fire the framework-bean memoizers in dependency-friendly order so their @Rest()
2833            // annotation walks (e.g. `@Rest(partParser=…)`, `@Rest(partSerializer=…)`, `@Rest(encoders=…)`,
2834            // etc.) execute eagerly inside the try-catch.  These walks MUTATE the cached creators that
2835            // downstream RestOpContext memoizers later copy from, so they must run before
2836            // getRestOperations() builds the per-op contexts.  We do NOT re-add results to the bean
2837            // store — the default suppliers registered earlier already cover lookups.
2838            initializeFrameworkBeansForRestOps();
2839
2840            // Force-initialize restOperations and restChildren now so that any construction failures
2841            // (e.g. bad @RestOp method or invalid child class) surface here inside the try-catch.
2842            getRestOperations();
2843            getRestChildren();
2844         }
2845
2846         // produces/consumes are resolved lazily via the produces/consumes memoizers below
2847         // (April 2026 refactor, 2026-04-19) — they walk the @Rest(produces=...) / @Rest(consumes=...)
2848         // chain first, then fall back to deriving the intersection of opContexts' supported media types.
2849
2850      } catch (BasicHttpException e) {
2851         initExceptionTemp = e;
2852         throw e;
2853      } catch (Exception e) {
2854         initExceptionTemp = new InternalServerError(e);
2855         throw e;
2856      } finally {
2857         initException = initExceptionTemp;
2858      }
2859   }

2861   @Override /* Overridden from Context */
2862   public RestSession.Builder createSession() {
2863      return RestSession.create(this);
2864   }

2870   /**
2871    * Memoized parser session-option keys from {@code @Rest(allowedParserOptions)}, after SVL resolution and comma expansion.
2872    *
2873    * <p>
2874    * When inheritance is not blocked, keys from {@link #parentContext} are included first, then this resource's own tokens.
2875    * Leading-hyphen tokens (e.g. {@code -foo}) remove earlier positive tokens.
2876    */
2877   private final Memoizer<SortedSet<String>> allowedParserOptions = memoizer(() -> {
2878      var l = new ArrayList<String>();
2879      var p = "allowedParserOptions";
2880      var pc = parentContext();
2881      if (isInherited(p) && pc != null)
2882         l.addAll(pc.getAllowedParserOptions());
2883      getRestAnnotationsForProperty(p).forEach(x -> resolveCdl(x.getStringArray(p)).forEach(l::add));
2884      return u(treeSetCi(removeNegations(l)));
2885   });

2904   /**
2905    * Memoized value of the {@code noInherit} annotation attribute from the nearest {@code @Rest} annotation.
2906    *
2907    * <p>
2908    * {@code noInherit} itself is never inherited; it only applies to the {@code @Rest} that declares it.
2909    */
2910   private final Memoizer<SortedSet<String>> noInherit = memoizer(() -> {
2911      var out = treeSet(String.CASE_INSENSITIVE_ORDER,
2912         getRestAnnotation()
2913            .map(x -> x.getStringArray("noInherit").orElse(StringUtils.EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY))
2914            .map(x -> resolveCdl(x).toList())
2915            .orElseGet(Collections::emptyList));
2916      // Dual noInherit source: when this is a mixin sub-context built from a host @Mixin(noInherit=...),
2917      // the host-declared cutoff tokens union with the mixin class's own @Rest(noInherit=...).  A token from
2918      // EITHER source cuts the host→mixin inheritance walk for that property.
2919      var rmNoInherit = resolvedMixinField();
2920      if (rmNoInherit != null)
2921         resolveCdl(rmNoInherit.overrides().noInherit()).forEach(out::add);
2922      return out;
2923   });

2928    * overrides (bare classes).

2932    * most-derived position of {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)} so the host override resolves as if
2933    * declared on the mixin class itself — list-shaped props append after the inherited host chain, replace-shaped
2934    * props win — but ahead of the mixin class's own {@code @Rest}, so the host override is authoritative.

2944   /**
2945    * Translates a host-declared {@link Mixin @Mixin} into a synthetic {@link Rest @Rest} carrying only its
2946    * override slots, so the standard {@code @Rest} resolution chain applies the overrides uniformly.
2947    *
2948    * @param m The {@code @Mixin} override declaration.
2949    * @return A synthetic {@code @Rest} populated from {@code m}'s override slots.

2951   private static Rest buildMixinOverrideRest(Mixin m) {
2952      // @formatter:off
2953      var b = RestAnnotation.create()
2954         .guards(m.guards())
2955         .roleGuard(m.roleGuard())
2956         .rolesDeclared(m.rolesDeclared())
2957         .converters(m.converters())
2958         .encoders(m.encoders())
2959         .serializers(m.serializers())
2960         .parsers(m.parsers())
2961         .responseProcessors(m.responseProcessors())

2963         .partSerializer(m.partSerializer())
2964         .partParser(m.partParser())
2965         .messages(m.messages())
2966         .defaultRequestHeaders(m.defaultRequestHeaders())
2967         .defaultResponseHeaders(m.defaultResponseHeaders())
2968         .defaultRequestAttributes(m.defaultRequestAttributes())
2969         .produces(m.produces())
2970         .consumes(m.consumes())
2971         .defaultAccept(m.defaultAccept())
2972         .defaultContentType(m.defaultContentType())
2973         .defaultCharset(m.defaultCharset())
2974         .maxInput(m.maxInput());

2976      return b.build();

3022   /**
3023    * Memoized list of every {@link Rest} annotation on the resource class and its supertypes, in child-to-parent order.
3024    *
3025    * <p>
3026    * For <b>host</b> contexts (top-level resources), {@link DefaultConfig} is always synthesized as the top-most
3027    * (parent-most) entry when not already present in the class hierarchy. This makes {@code DefaultConfig.@Rest(...)}
3028    * the framework's single source of truth for default lists (response processors, REST op args, encoders, parsers,
3029    * serializers, ...), while still letting bare {@code @Rest}-annotated resources inherit the framework defaults
3030    * without explicitly implementing {@link BasicUniversalConfig} or any other {@code DefaultConfig} descendant.
3031    * Resources that <i>do</i> implement {@code DefaultConfig} (transitively or directly) won't get a duplicate
3032    * entry — the list is dedup'd by the {@link Class} the annotation was declared on.
3033    *
3034    * <p>
3035    * For <b>mixin</b> sub-contexts the synthesized {@code DefaultConfig} fallback is omitted: the mixin's annotation
3036    * chain is composed with the host's chain by
3037    * {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String) getRestAnnotationsForProperty(...)}, and the host's chain already
3038    * supplies the {@code DefaultConfig} fallback (synthesized or transitive). Including it on the mixin too would
3039    * place a second {@code DefaultConfig} entry between the host's most-derived {@code @Rest} and the mixin's own
3040    * annotations in the combined parent-to-child walk, which would let the framework defaults silently override
3041    * a host's explicit per-property values for any property the mixin doesn't itself declare (e.g.
3042    * {@code partSerializer}, {@code partParser}).
3043    */
3044   private final Memoizer<List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>> restAnnotations = memoizer(() -> prependBuilderRestAnnotation(computeRawRestAnnotations()));
3045
3046   /**
3047    * Computes the raw {@code @Rest} annotation chain (most-derived first), folding in the framework
3048    * {@code DefaultConfig} annotations for non-mixin contexts, and — for a {@linkplain ContextKind.Child child}
3049    * context carrying a host-declared {@code @Child} seed — injecting the seed's synthetic {@code @Rest} at the
3050    * least-derived slot: {@code raw ++ [seed] ++ defaultConfigAnnotations}. This ranks the seed below everything
3051    * the child itself declares (child-wins scalars resolve to the child's own value when present) but above the
3052    * framework's {@code DefaultConfig} fallback (the seed is never masked by framework defaults). This holds
3053    * uniformly whether {@code DefaultConfig} is separately synthesized (the common case) or already embedded
3054    * within {@code raw} because the child class transitively implements {@code DefaultConfig} itself (e.g. by
3055    * extending {@code BasicRestServlet}/{@code BasicRestServletGroup}) — in the embedded case, {@code raw} is
3056    * split around the embedded {@code DefaultConfig} entry/entries so the seed still lands between the child's
3057    * own declarations and that entry, rather than after it. Does not include the synthetic builder annotation.
3058    *
3059    * @return The raw annotation chain.
3060    */
3061   private List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>> computeRawRestAnnotations() {
3062      var raw = getAnnotationProvider().find(Rest.class, ClassInfo.of(getResourceClass()));
3063      if (isMixinContextField())
3064         return raw;
3065      var seed = childSeedAnnotation.get();  // null for non-child contexts and no-seed children
3066      // The framework's DefaultConfig fallback is synthesized/appended for EVERY non-mixin context that
3067      // doesn't already transitively implement DefaultConfig itself — this happens unconditionally,
3068      // regardless of whether this context also carries an @Child seed (that baseline behavior predates
3069      // and is independent of @Child). Partition raw into "the resource's own real declarations" and any
3070      // DefaultConfig entries already embedded within its own hierarchy (e.g. because it extends
3071      // BasicRestServlet/BasicRestServletGroup, which implement DefaultConfig), so that when a seed IS
3072      // present it can always be inserted between them — below everything the child itself declares, but
3073      // above DefaultConfig's fallback values, whether that fallback is embedded here or synthesized below.
3074      var embeddedDefaultConfig = raw.stream().filter(ai -> ai.getAnnotatable() instanceof ClassInfo ci && DefaultConfig.class.equals(ci.inner())).toList();
3075      if (!embeddedDefaultConfig.isEmpty()) {
3076         if (seed == null)
3077            return raw;
3078         var ownDeclarations = raw.stream().filter(ai -> !(ai.getAnnotatable() instanceof ClassInfo ci && DefaultConfig.class.equals(ci.inner()))).toList();
3079         var combined = new ArrayList<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>(raw.size() + 1);
3080         combined.addAll(ownDeclarations);
3081         combined.add(seed);
3082         combined.addAll(embeddedDefaultConfig);
3083         return u(combined);
3084      }
3085      var defaultConfigAnnotations = getAnnotationProvider().find(Rest.class, ClassInfo.of(DefaultConfig.class));
3086      if (defaultConfigAnnotations.isEmpty())
3087         return seed == null ? raw : appendAnnotation(raw, seed);
3088      var combined = new ArrayList<>(raw);
3089      if (seed != null)
3090         combined.add(seed);
3091      combined.addAll(defaultConfigAnnotations);
3092      return u(combined);
3093   }

3160   private static String leadingEnumToken(String s) {
3161      s = trim(s);
3162      if (isEmpty(s))
3163         return s;
3164      int i = 0;
3165      while (i < s.length() && (Character.isLetter(s.charAt(i)) || s.charAt(i) == '_'))
3166         i++;
3167      return s.substring(0, i);
3168   }

3170   private <E extends Enum<E>> Optional<E> parseEnumConstant(Class<E> enumClass, String resolved) {
3171      var t = leadingEnumToken(trim(emptyIfNull(resolved)));
3172      if (isEmpty(t))
3173         return oe();
3174      try {
3175         return o(Enum.valueOf(enumClass, t));
3176      } catch (IllegalArgumentException ignored) {
3177         return oe();
3178      }
3179   }

3339   /**
3340    * The async-completion executor for this resource, resolved by name from the bean store; {@code null} when
3341    * {@code @Rest(asyncCompletionExecutor)} is blank (the common case).
3342    *
3343    * <p>
3344    * The memoizer throws {@link IllegalStateException} at first access if the bean name was supplied but no
3345    * matching {@link Executor} bean is found — this surfaces as a startup failure, not a silent no-op.
3346    */
3347   private final Memoizer<Executor> asyncCompletionExecutor = memoizer(() -> {
3348      // Programmatic override takes priority over the annotation chain.
3349      var name = resolveAsyncCompletionExecutorName();
3350      if (isBlank(name))
3351         return null;
3352      var resolved = beanStore().getBean(Executor.class, name);
3353      // Try ExecutorService as well (a common supertype users supply that is-a Executor).
3354      if (resolved.isEmpty())
3355         resolved = beanStore().getBean(ExecutorService.class, name).map(e -> (Executor) e);
3356      if (resolved.isEmpty())
3357         throw new IllegalStateException(
3358            "@Rest(asyncCompletionExecutor) on " + getResourceClass().getName()
3359               + " references bean name '" + name + "' but no Executor (or ExecutorService) bean"
3360               + " with that name is registered in the resource's bean store.");
3361      return resolved.get();
3362   });

3371   /**
3372    * Lazily-instantiated virtual-thread executor used by {@link RestOpInvoker} when
3373    * {@code @Rest(virtualThreads=true)} is set on this resource and the runtime is Java 21+.
3374    *
3375    * <p>
3376    * On Java 17/18/19/20 the supplier returns {@code null} and emits a one-shot {@code WARNING} log so the
3377    * resource degrades gracefully to caller-thread dispatch.
3378    */
3379   private final Memoizer<Executor> virtualThreadExecutor = memoizer(() -> {
3380      // NOTE: Intentionally not gated on resource-level {@code virtualThreadsEnabled.get()} — per-op
3381      // {@code @RestOp(virtualThreads="true")} can opt in even when the enclosing {@code @Rest} doesn't.
3382      // Callers ({@link RestOpInvoker#invokeOp}) only reach this method when the effective op-level flag is true,
3383      // so the warning emitted on Java &lt;21 is appropriate at first call regardless of where the flag is set.
3384      if (Runtime.version().feature() < 21) {
3385         ASYNC_LOG.log(Level.WARNING, () -> "virtualThreads=true configured on " + getResourceClass().getName()
3386            + " but runtime is Java " + Runtime.version().feature() + " — virtual-thread dispatch requires Java 21+. "
3387            + "Falling back to caller-thread dispatch.");
3388         return null;
3389      }
3390      try {
3391         var m = Executors.class.getMethod("newVirtualThreadPerTaskExecutor");
3392         return (Executor) m.invoke(null);
3393      } catch (ReflectiveOperationException e) {
3394         ASYNC_LOG.log(Level.WARNING, e, () -> "Reflective creation of virtual-thread executor failed on "
3395            + getResourceClass().getName() + " — falling back to caller-thread dispatch.");
3396         return null;
3397      }
3398   });

3495   /**
3496    * Property names that describe how a class is mounted on the URL tree, and therefore must NOT inherit from a
3497    * parent context when walking annotations on a {@linkplain #isMixinContext() mixin sub-context}.
3498    *
3499    * <p>
3500    * These properties are intentionally host-only:
3501    * <ul>
3502    *    <li>{@code path} / {@code paths} &mdash; top-level mount declarations only meaningful for the class registered
3503    *       with the servlet container.  A mixin sub-context inheriting the host's mount paths could cause
3504    *       nonsensical routing decisions.
3505    *    <li>{@code mixins} &mdash; the host owns the mixin discovery chain; a mixin sub-context inheriting the host's
3506    *       mixin list would loop or duplicate route registration.
3507    *    <li>{@code children} &mdash; child sub-resources are tied to the host's URL namespace, not the mixin's.
3508    * </ul>
3509    *
3510    * <p>
3511    * The host's {@link RestContext} reads {@code path}/{@code paths} from its own annotation chain only (via
3512    * {@link #getRestAnnotations()} rather than {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)}); this allowlist
3513    * preserves that invariant when a mixin sub-context walks annotations for these properties.
3514    */
3515   private static final Set<String> HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES = Set.of(
3516      "path", "paths", "mixins", "children"
3517   );
3518
3519   /**
3520    * The list-shaped {@code @Rest} contribution properties that {@link Mixin#mergeIntoHost() @Mixin(mergeIntoHost=true)}
3521    * folds from an adopted mixin's own {@code @Rest} chain into the <b>host</b> resource's corresponding chain.
3522    *
3523    * <p>
3524    * Mirrors the "List-shaped" override set documented on {@link Mixin}: these are append-semantics properties, so a
3525    * mixin's contributions can be safely concatenated after the host's own chain (with the individual list builders'
3526    * same-class de-duplication).  Replace-shaped properties (e.g. {@code restDebugFormatter}, {@code partSerializer}) and the
3527    * {@link #HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES host-only} properties are deliberately excluded &mdash; merging them would be a
3528    * conflict-resolution / namespace concern, not an append, and is out of scope for this opt-in directive.
3529    */
3530   private static final Set<String> MERGEABLE_LIST_PROPERTIES = Set.of(
3531      "serializers", "parsers", "encoders", "converters", "guards",
3532      "responseProcessors", "restOpArgs", "defaultRequestHeaders",
3533      "defaultResponseHeaders", "defaultRequestAttributes", "produces", "consumes"
3534   );
3535
3536   /**
3537    * Returns the {@link Rest} annotations on the resource class hierarchy for the specified property,
3538    * in <b>parent-to-child</b> order, with {@code noInherit} cutoff applied.
3539    *
3540    * <p>
3541    * Used by both this class and {@link RestOpContext} to walk the class-level annotation chain when
3542    * computing memoized op-level settings that inherit from class-level {@code @Rest(...)} attributes.
3543    *
3544    * <p>
3545    * When this context is a {@linkplain #isMixinContext() mixin sub-context}, the parent context's annotation
3546    * chain is prepended to the mixin's own &mdash; serializers, parsers, encoders, converters, response
3547    * processors, guards, restDebugFormatter, messages, and other contribution lists inherit from the
3548    * host first, with the mixin's contributions appended.  The local {@code @Rest(noInherit)} on the mixin
3549    * cuts off the parent walk for any specific property; the {@link #HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES} allowlist
3550    * unconditionally skips the parent walk for properties whose semantics are host-only (mount paths, the
3551    * mixin discovery chain, and child sub-resources).
3552    *
3553    * @param name The annotation property name (e.g. {@code "converters"}, {@code "guards"}).
3554    * @return A stream of {@link AnnotationInfo} entries in parent-to-child order, never {@code null}.
3555    */
3556   Stream<AnnotationInfo<Rest>> getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String name) {
3557      var localAnnotations = getRestAnnotations();
3558      List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>> annotations;
3559      if (isMixinContextField() && parentContext != null && !HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES.contains(name) && !noInherit.get().contains(name)) {
3560         var combined = new ArrayList<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>(localAnnotations.size() + parentContext.getRestAnnotations().size());
3561         // Local (child-to-parent) annotations first; then parent's (child-to-parent).
3562         // Since the final stream is reversed by rstream(), the combined order becomes:
3563         //   parent's parent-to-child, then mixin's parent-to-child — i.e. host annotations come first, then mixin.
3564         combined.addAll(localAnnotations);
3565         combined.addAll(parentContext.getRestAnnotations());
3566         annotations = combined;
3567      } else {
3568         annotations = localAnnotations;
3569      }
3570      var cutoff = annotations.size();
3571      for (var i = 0; i < annotations.size(); i++) {
3572         if (resolveCdl(annotations.get(i).getStringArray("noInherit")).anyMatch(name::equalsIgnoreCase)) {
3573            cutoff = i + 1;
3574            break;
3575         }
3576      }
3577      var resolved = annotations.subList(0, cutoff);
3578      // Mixin override injection: for a mixin sub-context carrying host @Mixin overrides, the
3579      // synthetic override annotation is the most-derived contribution.  `resolved` is in child-to-parent order
3580      // (it is reversed to parent-to-child by rstream below), so prepending here places the override LAST in the
3581      // emitted stream — list-shaped props append it after the inherited host+mixin chain, replace-shaped props
3582      // take it as the final (winning) value.  It is added after the noInherit cutoff scan so it is never itself
3583      // cut, and HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES are excluded (path/paths/mixins/children are not @Mixin override slots).
3584      var override = HOST_ONLY_PROPERTIES.contains(name) ? null : mixinOverrideAnnotation.get();
3585      Stream<AnnotationInfo<Rest>> hostStream;
3586      if (override == null) {
3587         hostStream = rstream(resolved);
3588      } else {
3589         var withOverride = new ArrayList<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>(resolved.size() + 1);
3590         withOverride.add(override);
3591         withOverride.addAll(resolved);
3592         hostStream = rstream(withOverride);
3593      }
3594      // Opt-in @Mixin(mergeIntoHost=true) directive: for a host context and a list-shaped property, append the
3595      // adopted mixin(s)' own @Rest contributions AFTER the host's chain (parent-to-child), so the host's own
3596      // endpoints pick up the mixin's list-shaped attributes.  Default behavior (no opted-in mixin) is unchanged.
3597      if (! isMixinContextField()) {
3598         if (MERGEABLE_LIST_PROPERTIES.contains(name)) {
3599            var merged = mergeIntoHostMixinAnnotations.get();
3600            if (! merged.isEmpty())
3601               hostStream = Stream.concat(hostStream, merged.stream());
3602         }
3603         // Mixin-declared @Rest(mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHost=true) opt-in: fold the opted-in mixin's OWN response
3604         // processors into the host's chain — response-processor-scoped only (never other list-shaped attributes).
3605         if (eq(name, "responseProcessors")) {
3606            var mergedRp = mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHostMixinAnnotations.get();
3607            if (! mergedRp.isEmpty())
3608               hostStream = Stream.concat(hostStream, mergedRp.stream());
3609         }
3610      }
3611      return hostStream;
3612   }
3613
3614   /**
3615    * The {@code @Rest} annotation chains (parent-to-child, framework {@code DefaultConfig} entries excluded) of any
3616    * mixin the host opted into merging via {@link Mixin#mergeIntoHost() @Mixin(mergeIntoHost=true)}, appended by
3617    * {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)} for each {@link #MERGEABLE_LIST_PROPERTIES mergeable} list-shaped
3618    * property so the mixin's list-shaped {@code @Rest} attributes fold into the host's own chains.
3619    *
3620    * <p>
3621    * Empty for mixin sub-contexts and for hosts with no opted-in mixins &mdash; keeping the default (drop) behavior
3622    * for every existing resource.  Built once at memoizer-init time (zero per-request cost).
3623    */
3624   private final Memoizer<List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>> mergeIntoHostMixinAnnotations = memoizer(() -> {
3625      if (isMixinContextField())
3626         return List.of();
3627      var out = new ArrayList<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>();
3628      for (var rm : getResolvedMixins()) {
3629         if (! rm.overrides().mergeIntoHost() || rm.type() == resourceClass())
3630            continue;
3631         // Fold in the mixin class's OWN @Rest chain (parent-to-child), excluding the framework DefaultConfig
3632         // entries — those are already contributed by the host's own chain, so re-adding them would double-count.
3633         rstream(getAnnotationProvider().find(Rest.class, ClassInfo.of(rm.type())))
3634            .filter(ai -> ! (ai.getAnnotatable() instanceof ClassInfo ci && DefaultConfig.class.equals(ci.inner())))
3635            .forEach(out::add);
3636      }
3637      return u(out);
3638   });
3639
3640   /**
3641    * The OWN {@code @Rest} annotation chains (parent-to-child, framework {@code DefaultConfig} entries excluded) of any
3642    * mixin that opts into folding its response processors into the host via
3643    * {@link Rest#mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHost() @Rest(mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHost=true)} on its own class,
3644    * appended by {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)} for the {@code responseProcessors} property only so the
3645    * mixin's {@code responseProcessors} fold into the host's own chain under a plain {@link Rest#mixins() mixins=}
3646    * reference.
3647    *
3648    * <p>
3649    * This is the mixin-declared, response-processor-scoped counterpart to the host-declared
3650    * {@link Mixin#mergeIntoHost() @Mixin(mergeIntoHost=true)} directive handled by
3651    * {@link #mergeIntoHostMixinAnnotations}: it folds <b>only</b> {@code responseProcessors}, never other list-shaped
3652    * attributes.  Empty for mixin sub-contexts and for hosts with no opted-in mixins &mdash; keeping the default (drop)
3653    * behavior for every mixin that does not declare the opt-in.  Built once at memoizer-init time (zero per-request
3654    * cost).
3655    */
3656   private final Memoizer<List<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>> mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHostMixinAnnotations = memoizer(() -> {
3657      if (isMixinContextField())
3658         return List.of();
3659      var out = new ArrayList<AnnotationInfo<Rest>>();
3660      for (var rm : getResolvedMixins()) {
3661         if (rm.type() == resourceClass())
3662            continue;
3663         // Fold in the mixin class's OWN @Rest chain (parent-to-child), excluding the framework DefaultConfig
3664         // entries, but only when the mixin's own @Rest declares the mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHost opt-in.
3665         var mixinRest = rstream(getAnnotationProvider().find(Rest.class, ClassInfo.of(rm.type())))
3666            .filter(ai -> ! (ai.getAnnotatable() instanceof ClassInfo ci && DefaultConfig.class.equals(ci.inner())))
3667            .toList();
3668         if (mixinRest.stream().anyMatch(ai -> ai.inner().mergeResponseProcessorsIntoHost()))
3669            out.addAll(mixinRest);
3670      }
3671      return u(out);
3672   });
3673
3674   /**
3675    * For a {@linkplain #isMixinContext() mixin sub-context}, returns the <b>host</b> resource class's
3676    * class-level annotation infos (host class chain, in parent-to-child order) so a mixin operation can
3677    * inherit the host's class-level {@link ContextApply @ContextApply} config
3678    * (e.g. {@link HtmlDocConfig @HtmlDocConfig},
3679    * {@link SerializerConfig @SerializerConfig}).
3680    *
3681    * <p>
3682    * Used by {@link RestOpContext.Builder} to prepend the host's class-level config annotations <i>ahead of</i>
3683    * the mixin class's own class annotations in the op's annotation work-list, so the effective precedence is
3684    * method &gt; mixin-class &gt; host-class.  This is the page-decoration counterpart of the context-level
3685    * inheritance walk in {@link #getRestAnnotationsForProperty(String)}: that walk inherits {@code @Rest}
3686    * properties (serializers, parsers, guards, ...) from the host, while this method inherits standalone
3687    * class-level config annotations that are not {@code @Rest} attributes.
3688    *
3689    * <p>
3690    * Inheritance is automatic for every mixin sub-context.  A mixin can opt out of inheriting a specific host
3691    * config annotation by naming its annotation type in {@link Rest#noInherit() @Rest(noInherit)} on the mixin
3692    * class (e.g. {@code @Rest(noInherit={"HtmlDocConfig"})}), reusing the same {@code noInherit} resolution that
3693    * gates the context-level walk so the opt-out is uniform.  For non-mixin contexts (top-level resources and
3694    * child resources) this returns an empty stream &mdash; only mixin ops inherit from a composition host.
3695    *
3696    * @param ap The annotation provider to resolve the host class chain with.
3697    * @return The host class chain's annotation infos in parent-to-child order, or an empty stream when this is
3698    *    not a mixin sub-context (or has no parent).
3699    */
3700   Stream<AnnotationInfo<?>> getInheritedHostClassAnnotations(AnnotationProvider ap) {
3701      if (! isMixinContextField() || parentContext == null)
3702         return Stream.empty();
3703      var blocked = noInherit.get();
3704      return rstream(ap.find(ClassInfo.of(parentContext.getResourceClass()), SELF, PARENTS))
3705         .filter(ai -> ! blocked.contains(ai.annotationType().getSimpleName()));
3706   }

3740   /**

3743    * <p>

3745    *
3746    * @param property The annotation attribute name (e.g. {@code "allowedSerializerOptions"}).
3747    * @return {@code true} if parent values should be included.

3749   protected boolean isInherited(String property) {

3753   /**
3754    * Returns {@code true} if the local {@code @Rest(noInherit=...)} list contains {@code property} as a literal token.
3755    *
3756    * <p>
3757    * Unlike the {@link #noInherit} memoizer this performs a raw, SVL-free, comma-split check on the local
3758    * {@code @Rest} annotation. It exists for callers that are themselves on the dependency chain of the
3759    * {@code varResolver} memoizer (e.g. the {@code messages} memoizer) — those callers can't reach the
3760    * regular {@link #noInherit} memoizer without inducing a cycle, because the regular path runs
3761    * {@code resolveCdl(...)} → {@link #getVarResolver()} → {@link #getMessages()} → back to messages.
3762    *
3763    * @param property The property name (e.g. {@code "messages"}). Case-insensitive comparison.
3764    * @return {@code true} if {@code property} is named as a literal token in the local {@code @Rest(noInherit=...)}.
3765    */
3766   private boolean isNoInheritLiteral(String property) {
3767      var fromRest = getRestAnnotation()
3768         .map(x -> x.getStringArray("noInherit").orElse(StringUtils.EMPTY_STRING_ARRAY))
3769         .stream()
3770         .flatMap(Arrays::stream)
3771         .filter(Objects::nonNull)
3772         .flatMap(s -> StringUtils.split(s, ',').stream())
3773         .map(String::trim)
3774         .filter(StringUtils::isNotBlank)
3775         .anyMatch(property::equalsIgnoreCase);
3776      if (fromRest)
3777         return true;
3778      // Also honor a host @Mixin(noInherit=...) token (raw / SVL-free, same as the @Rest path above) so the
3779      // messages memoizer's cutoff check sees both noInherit sources without inducing the resolver cycle.
3780      if (resolvedMixin != null) {
3781         for (var s : resolvedMixin.overrides().noInherit())
3782            for (var t : StringUtils.split(s, ','))
3783               if (eqic(property, t.trim()))
3784                  return true;
3785      }
3786      return false;
3787   }

3789   /**
3790    * Resolves comma-delimited annotation values with SVL variable substitution.
3791    *
3792    * @param values Raw annotation attribute values.
3793    * @return A stream of trimmed, non-blank tokens.
3794    */
3795   private Stream<String> resolveCdl(String...values) {
3796      if (values == null || values.length == 0)
3797         return Stream.empty();
3798      return Arrays.stream(values)
3799         .filter(Objects::nonNull)
3800         .map(this::resolve)
3801         .map(StringUtils::split)
3802         .flatMap(Collection::stream)
3803         .map(String::trim)
3804         .filter(StringUtils::isNotBlank);
3805   }
3806
3807   private Stream<String> resolveCdl(Optional<String[]> values) {
3808      return values.isEmpty() ? Stream.empty() : resolveCdl(values.get());
3809   }

3817   protected String resolve(String s) {
3818      return getVarResolver().resolve(s);
3819   }

3821   /**
3822    * Returns the parser session-option keys allowed for this resource.

3839   /**
3840    * Called during servlet destruction to invoke all {@link RestDestroy} methods.
3841    *
3842    * <p>
3843    * Fires this context's own {@code @RestDestroy} methods first, then walks any mixin sub-contexts
3844    * (host destroys before each mixin's), then any {@code @Rest(children=...)} sub-resources, then closes
3845    * the bean store. Mixin sub-contexts recursively destroy themselves via the same path; flat-inheritance
3846    * guarantees no further mixin descent occurs from inside a mixin sub-context.
3847    */
3848   public void destroy() {
3849      for (var x : destroyInvokerPair.get().invokers) {
3850         try {
3851            x.invoke(beanStore, getResource());
3852         } catch (Exception e) {
3853            getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, unwrap(e), () -> f("Error occurred invoking servlet-destroy method '%s'.", x.getFullName()));
3854         }
3855      }
3856      if (!isMixinContext) {
3857         for (var mctx : mixinContexts.get().values()) {
3858            try {
3859               mctx.destroy();
3860            } catch (Exception e) {
3861               getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, unwrap(e), () -> f("Error occurred destroying mixin sub-context '%s'.", mctx.getResourceClass().getName()));
3862            }
3863         }
3864      }
3865      var childrenRef = getRestChildren();
3866      if (nn(childrenRef))
3867         childrenRef.destroy();
3868      try {
3869         beanStore.close();
3870      } catch (Exception e) {
3871         getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, unwrap(e), () -> "Error occurred closing bean store.");
3872      }
3873   }

3875   /**
3876    * The main service method.
3877    *
3878    * <p>
3879    * Subclasses can optionally override this method if they want to tailor the behavior of requests.
3880    *
3881    * @param resource
3882    *    The REST servlet or bean that this context defines.
3883    *    <br>Note that this bean may not be the same bean used during initialization as it may have been replaced at runtime.
3884    * @param r1 The incoming HTTP servlet request object.
3885    * @param r2 The incoming HTTP servlet response object.
3886    * @throws ServletException General servlet exception.
3887    * @throws IOException Thrown by underlying stream.
3888    */
3889   public void execute(Object resource, HttpServletRequest r1, HttpServletResponse r2) throws ServletException, IOException {
3890
3891      // Must be careful not to bleed thread-locals.
3892      if (nn(localSession.get()))
3893         LOG.warning("WARNING:  Thread-local call object was not cleaned up from previous request.  %s, thread=[%s]", this, Thread.currentThread().getName());
3894
3895      RestSession.Builder sb = createSession().resource(resource).req(r1).res(r2);
3896
3897      try {
3898
3899         if (nn(initException))
3900            throw initException;
3901
3902         // If the resource path contains variables (e.g. @Rest(path="/f/{a}/{b}"), then we want to resolve
3903         // those variables and push the servletPath to include the resolved variables.  The new pathInfo will be
3904         // the remainder after the new servletPath.
3905         // Only do this for the top-level resource because the logic for child resources are processed next.
3906         if (pathMatcher.hasVars() && parentContext == null) {
3907            var sp = sb.req().getServletPath();
3908            var pi = sb.getPathInfoUndecoded();
3909            var upi2 = UrlPath.of(pi == null ? sp : sp + pi);
3910            var uppm = pathMatcher.match(upi2);
3911         if (nn(uppm) && ! uppm.hasEmptyVars()) {
3912            sb.pathVars(uppm.getVars());
3913            var pathInfo = o(validatePathInfo(nie(urlDecode(uppm.getSuffix())))).orElse("\u0000");
3914            var servletPath = validateServletPath(uppm.getPrefix());
3915            sb.req(new HttpServletRequestWrapper(sb.req()) {
3916               @Override
3917               public String getPathInfo() {
3918                  return pathInfo.charAt(0) == (char)0 ? null : pathInfo;
3919               }
3920               @Override
3921               public String getServletPath() {
3922                  return servletPath;
3923               }
3924            });
3925         } else {
3926               var call = sb.build();
3927               installCaptureIfNeeded(call);
3928               call.status(SC_NOT_FOUND).finish();
3929               return;
3930            }
3931         }
3932
3933         // If this resource has child resources, try to recursively call them.
3934         var childMatch = getRestChildren().findMatch(sb);
3935         if (childMatch.isPresent()) {
3936            var uppm = childMatch.get().getPathMatch();
3937            var rc = childMatch.get().getChildContext();
3938            if (! uppm.hasEmptyVars()) {
3939               sb.pathVars(uppm.getVars());
3940               var pathInfo = o(validatePathInfo(nie(urlDecode(uppm.getSuffix())))).orElse("\u0000");
3941               var servletPath = validateServletPath(sb.req().getServletPath() + uppm.getPrefix());
3942               var childRequest = new HttpServletRequestWrapper(sb.req()) {
3943                  @Override
3944                  public String getPathInfo() {
3945                     return pathInfo.charAt(0) == (char)0 ? null : pathInfo;
3946                  }
3947                  @Override
3948                  public String getServletPath() {
3949                     return servletPath;
3950                  }
3951               };
3952               rc.execute(rc.getResource(), childRequest, sb.res());
3953            } else {
3954               var call = sb.build();
3955               installCaptureIfNeeded(call);
3956               call.status(SC_NOT_FOUND).finish();
3957            }
3958            return;
3959         }
3960
3961      } catch (Exception e) {
3962         // This throwaway error session opens a requestId LogContext scope in its constructor but never reaches
3963         // finish(); close it here so the (possibly pooled) request thread does not leak the scope. The subsequent
3964         // build() below re-resolves to the same id via the honor-existing-attribute rung.
3965         var errorSession = sb.build();
3966         try {
3967            handleError(errorSession, convertThrowable(e));
3968         } finally {
3969            errorSession.closeRequestIdScope();
3970         }
3971      }
3972
3973      var s = sb.build();
3974
3975      try {
3976         localSession.set(s);
3977         installCaptureIfNeeded(s);
3978         startCall(s);
3979         s.run();
3980      } catch (Exception e) {
3981         handleError(s, convertThrowable(e));
3982      } finally {
3983         try {
3984            s.finish();
3985            endCall(s);
3986            // For mixin endpoints, dual-fire endCall on the mixin sub-context after the host's so host
3987            // hooks fire first, then the mixin's. Skip when no operation was resolved (e.g. 404 paths).
3988            var os = s.getOpSessionOrNull();
3989            if (os != null) {
3990               var opRestContext = os.getContext().getContext();
3991               if (opRestContext.isMixinContext)
3992                  opRestContext.endCall(s);
3993            }
3994         } finally {
3995            localSession.remove();
3996         }
3997      }
3998   }

4316   /**
4317    * Returns the resolved top-level mount paths for this resource.
4318    *
4319    * <p>
4320    * Computed once during {@link RestContext} construction by walking the runtime-override resolution chain
4321    * (highest precedence first):
4322    * <ol>
4323    *    <li><b>Programmatic</b> &mdash; {@link Builder#paths(String...)} setter (or {@link Args#paths()} record
4324    *       field). Highest precedence; an empty array (not {@code null}) explicitly clears the mount list.
4325    *    <li><b>Getter</b> &mdash; the resource's {@code getPaths()} virtual method (defined on
4326    *       {@code RestServlet} and {@code RestResource}). {@code null} return inherits; non-{@code null} (including
4327    *       empty array) wins over the annotation default.
4328    *    <li><b>Annotation default</b> &mdash; {@link Rest#paths()}, walked top-down across the resource-class
4329    *       hierarchy with the most-derived non-empty value winning. Each element is
4330    *       <a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/RestServerSvlVariables">REST Server SVL Variables</a>-resolved
4331    *       against the bootstrap {@link VarResolver VarResolver}, then comma-split (trim
4332    *       each piece, drop empties).  A single element like {@code "${C:health.paths}"} can therefore expand
4333    *       to multiple mount paths.
4334    * </ol>
4335    *
4336    * <p>
4337    * The resolved array is what hosting runtimes &mdash; Jetty's auto-discovery flow in
4338    * {@code JettyServerComponent}, and Spring Boot's {@code ServletRegistrationBean} wiring &mdash; should
4339    * consume when mounting the resource at the top level.
4340    *
4341    * <h4 class='section'>Notes:</h4><ul>
4342    *    <li class='note'>
4343    *       Returns an empty array (not {@code null}) when none of the rungs resolve. Hosting runtimes interpret
4344    *       an empty array as &quot;no top-level mounts&quot; and surface a clear error naming the resource.
4345    *    <li class='note'>
4346    *       The scalar {@link #getPath()} accessor remains orthogonal to this method.
4347    * </ul>
4348    *
4349    * <h4 class='section'>See Also:</h4><ul>
4350    *    <li class='ja'>{@link Rest#paths()}
4351    * </ul>
4352    *
4353    * @return The resolved mount paths (never {@code null}; possibly empty).
4354    * @since 10.0.0
4355    */
4356   public String[] getPaths() { return cp(paths); }

4468   /**
4469    * Returns the bean store that this resource exposes to its {@link Rest#children() @Rest(children)} sub-resources.
4470    *
4471    * <p>
4472    * This store layers this resource's own {@link Bean @Bean} method results and non-<jk>null</jk>
4473    * {@link Bean @Bean} field values on top of the {@link #getBootstrapBeanStore() bootstrap bean store}, and is
4474    * used as the bootstrap bean store of every child.  Since each child's inheritable store sits on top of its
4475    * parent's, a grandchild sees the beans of its parent, its grandparent, and so on up to the root (including
4476    * any Spring context bridged in at the root by {@code SpringRestServlet}).
4477    *
4478    * <p>
4479    * Precedence and isolation:
4480    * <ul>
4481    *    <li>A child's own {@code @Bean} of the same type and name wins over the inherited one.
4482    *    <li>Framework-managed types (serializers, parsers, {@link MethodExecStore}, {@link RestChildren}, ...) are
4483    *       <i>not</i> exported; each child builds its own from its own {@code @Rest} configuration.
4484    *    <li>Beans flow down only: a child's beans are never visible to its parent or its siblings.
4485    * </ul>
4486    *
4487    * <h4 class='section'>Example:</h4>
4488    * <p class='bjava'>
4489    *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(children={PetResource.<jk>class</jk>, OrderResource.<jk>class</jk>})
4490    *    <jk>public class</jk> RootResources <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestServletGroup {
4491    *
4492    *       <jc>// One store shared by every child resource.</jc>
4493    *       <ja>@Bean</ja>
4494    *       <jk>public</jk> PetStore petStore() {
4495    *          <jk>return new</jk> PetStore();
4496    *       }
4497    *    }
4498    *
4499    *    <ja>@Rest</ja>(path=<js>"/pets"</js>)
4500    *    <jk>public class</jk> PetResource <jk>extends</jk> BasicRestResource {
4501    *
4502    *       <ja>@Inject</ja> PetStore <jf>store</jf>;  <jc>// Resolved from the group's @Bean method.</jc>
4503    *
4504    *       <ja>@RestGet</ja>(<js>"/"</js>)
4505    *       <jk>public</jk> Collection&lt;Pet&gt; getPets() {
4506    *          <jk>return</jk> <jf>store</jf>.getPets();
4507    *       }
4508    *    }
4509    * </p>
4510    *
4511    * @return The bean store exposed to child resources.
4512    * @since 10.0.0
4513    */
4514   public WritableBeanStore getInheritableBeanStore() { return inheritableBeanStore; }
